raw.title: Senior Manager, AI Customer Success
raw.excerpt: Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust.
raw.description:
Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, AI Customer Success to help us build and lead the Customer Success team for Source by Webflow, a new platform where marketing teams and their AI agents launch, optimize and scale digital experiences together. Source is in limited research preview today, and this team will support customers as it moves into commercial availability.

You’ll start as a player/coach, owning a small portfolio of strategic enterprise Source accounts, including renewals and growth. As Source adoption grows, you’ll build and scale the team. Your job is to help customers get agents into production, prove the business value, and turn that into retention and expansion. This is a first of its kind role for a first of its kind product. There is no playbook yet, and you will write it.

About the role:

  • Location: Remote-first (United States)
  • Full-time
  • Permanent
  • Exempt
  • The cash compensation for this role is tailored to align with the cost of labor in different geographic markets. We've structured the base pay ranges for this role into zones for our geographic markets, and the specific base pay within the range will be determined by the candidate’s geographic location, job-related experience, knowledge, qualifications, and skills.
    • United States (all figures cited below are in USD and pertain to workers in the United States)
      • Zone A: $204,000 - $255,000
      • Zone B: $190,000 - $238,000
      • Zone C: $177,500 - $222,000

For sales roles, the ranges provided are the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) ranges, meaning that the ranges include both the sales commissions target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Webflow and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’smarket location, job related experience, knowledge, qualifications, and skills. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends

Please visit our Careers page for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.

  • Application Information:
    • Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled
    • This posting is for a new position
  • Reporting to the Senior Director, Customers Success

As a Senior Manager, AI Customer Success, you’ll …

  • Lead and grow the Source CS team: hire and coach as adoption grows, and build a culture of experimentation and shared learning.
  • Manage strategic Source accounts: serve as an executive sponsor and build relationships with senior marketing, web and engineering leaders.
  • Drive retention and expansion: own renewals, forecasting and account health; partner with Sales on expansion and negotiations; and guide account plans that grow use cases and adoption.
  • Turn Source use cases into results: lead discovery workshops, pilots and agent building, helping customers navigate rollout, adoption and change management.
  • Own customer outcomes: partner with Forward Deployed Engineers and Solution Architects to move from pilot to production, define success and ROI, and use performance data to drive improvements.
  • Enable customers to scale: establish agent permissions, autonomy and review practices, and develop customer champions and enablement.
  • Build the Source CS operating model: create playbooks, health metrics and AI-powered workflows; partner across teams to shape the roadmap and develop customer references and case studies

About you:

Requirements:

  • 8+ years in customer success, account management or consulting at a B2B software company, including enterprise accounts and executive relationships.
  • 2+ years managing a customer success, account management or customer growth team.
  • Proven success driving retention, expansion and revenue growth against commercial targets such as net revenue retention.
  • Ability to influence executives, both with customers and internally.
  • Technical aptitude across codebases, deployment pipelines, integrations, permissions and security, with the ability to partner credibly with developers. Production coding is not required.
  • Experience in at least one of the following:
    • Applied AI: building real AI workflows or agents, evaluating their output and setting realistic expectations.Digital transformation: leading complex enterprise programs involving integrated systems, workflow automation or platform migrations.
    • Digital transformation: leading complex enterprise programs involving integrated systems, workflow automation or platform migrations.

You’ll thrive as a Senior Manager, AI Customer Success if you:

  • Think in systems, spot bottlenecks and build repeatable processes with measurable results.
  • Are comfortable with ambiguity and energized by building a team, product motion or playbook from the ground up.
  • Understand how marketing and digital experience tools, including CMS, martech and analytics, connect to business outcomes.
  • Bring relevant experience with usage or consumption based pricing, agencies or systems integrators, or Webflow and its customers. These are welcome strengths, rather than requirements.
  • Stay curious and open to growth — demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact.

Our Core Behaviors:

  • Build lasting customer trust. We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first.
  • Win together. We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act.
  • Reinvent ourselves. We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible.
  • Own it all the way. We move fast because the moment demands it, and we hold ourselves accountable to deliver outcomes — for each other, and for customers.

Benefits

  • Ownership in what you help build. Every permanent Webflower receives equity (RSUs) in our growing, privately held company.
  • Health coverage that actually covers you. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums.
  • Support for every stage of family life. 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions.
  • Time off that’s actually off. Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired.
  • Wellness for the whole you. Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching.
  • Invest in your future. A 401(k) with 100% employer match (up to $6,000/year) in the U.S., and support for retirement savings globally.
  • Monthly stipends that flex with your life. Localized support for work and wellness expenses — from Wi-Fi to workouts.
  • Bonus for building together. All full-time, permanent, non-commission employees are eligible for our annual WIN bonus program.

Temporary employees may be eligible for paid holiday and time off, statutory leaves of absence, and company-sponsored medical benefits depending on their Fixed Term Contract and their country/state of employment.

Remote, together

At Webflow, equality is a core tenet of our culture. We are an Equal Opportunity (EEO)/Veterans/Disabled Employer and are committed to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Employment decisions are made on the basis of job-related criteria without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other classification protected by applicable law. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Webflow will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Stay connected

Not ready to apply, but want to be part of the Webflow community? Consider following our story on our Webflow Blog, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and/or Glassdoor.

Please note:

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Upon interview scheduling, instructions for confidential accommodation requests will be administered.

To join Webflow, you'll need a valid right to work authorization depending on the country of employment.

If you are extended an offer, that offer may be contingent upon your successful completion of a background check, which will be conducted in accordance with applicable laws. We may obtain one or more background screening reports about you, solely for employment purposes.

For information about how Webflow processes your personal information, please review Webflow’s Applicant Privacy Notice.

raw.description:
Why Apply to New Frontier Immigration Law.

Join the New Frontier Immigration Law team and help change the lives of 1 million undocumented immigrants in the USA. Our mid-sized law firm in Phoenix, AZ is committed to humanitarian-based immigration and finding innovative solutions for seemingly impossible problems.

Are you ready to join one of the fastest-growing law firms in the US, where incredible opportunities await? Here, we don’t just offer a job: we provide an environment that challenges you to become the best version of yourself.

  • Learn more about New Frontier Immigration here.
  • Learn more about our CEO/Founder Hillary here.
  • Learn more about our Core Values here.

Role Objective

We are looking for an organized, empathetic, and detail-oriented Pre-Filing Specialist to join our Onboarding & Evidence Team. In this role, you will be the bridge between our new clients and the legal team, ensuring a seamless transition into our firm. You will manage the initial stages of the client journey—from opening matters and conducting onboarding calls to gathering, translating, and organizing crucial evidence.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, excels at high-volume caseload management, and possesses the emotional intelligence needed to support clients going through stressful or sensitive situations.

Responsibilities/Duties

  • Conduct onboarding calls: Welcome new clients, gather required background information, and explain the onboarding process clearly without providing legal advice.
  • Client care: Maintain consistent communication with clients, providing timely updates regarding next steps and following up on outstanding documents, questionnaires, signatures, photos, and records.
  • Language support: Translate client documents and assist with Spanish/English interpretation during calls when needed.
  • File setup: Open new client matters in Filevine, ensuring client profiles are accurate. Review contracts, HubSpot info, intake notes, and prior communications before starting onboarding.
  • Evidence gathering: Collect, review, organize, rename, and upload client evidence.
  • Government requests: Request, track, and process government evidence (including FOIA and background requests) according to firm training.
  • Documentation: Prepare clear case notes, task updates, and next-step documentation within Filevine.
  • Issue identification: Spot missing information, urgent issues, or complex client questions, and identify when a matter requires attorney or paralegal review.
  • Cross-department coordination: Partner with paralegals, attorneys, reception, sales, finance, and other departments to keep cases moving.
  • Case handoff: Support the smooth transition of cases to the paralegal team once onboarding and evidence collection are complete.
  • This role requires strong client-centered communication. You must be able to speak with clients in a calm, respectful, and empathetic way, especially when they are frustrated, scared, confused, or emotional.

Requirements.

  • High-Volume Management: Strong organization and time management skills; ability to handle multiple priorities and a heavy caseload.
  • Attention to Detail: Deep focus on accuracy when following processes and documenting case work.
  • Adaptability: Comfort with process changes, shifting priorities, and fast-paced environments.
  • Tech-Savvy: Proficiency with case management systems, calendars, email, Teams, and spreadsheets.
  • Bilingual Proficiency: English/Spanish bilingual skills are highly preferred for client communication, interpretation, and document translation.
  • Professional Boundaries: Clear understanding of the difference between administrative/legal support and giving legal advice.
  • Immigration Law: Prior experience in immigration legal support is a plus.
  • Case Types: Familiarity with family-based, humanitarian, consular processes, T Visa, U Visa, VAWA, AOS, or similar case types.
  • Background Requests: Experience requesting or processing FOIAs, FBI background checks, police records, or court records.
  • Software: Experience using Filevine, HubSpot, Monday.com, Outlook, or Teams is highly advantageous.

What We Offer.

  • Full-time, long-term remote contract position.
  • $26,000 to $30,000 net depending on experience.
  • M-F 9am to 6pm Arizona Time.
  • The opportunity to work alongside a high-performing, fast-growing US immigration law firm.
  • A supportive, mission-driven team culture that values professional growth.
Salary: $26,000 to $30,000 MXN DOE

raw.excerpt: Data Program AssociateAcuityMD is the AI platform for MedTech trusted by over 500 MedTech companies – including 16 of the top 20.
raw.description:
Data Program Associate

AcuityMD is the AI platform for MedTech trusted by over 500 MedTech companies – including 16 of the top 20. Commercial leaders use AcuityMD to identify target markets, surface top opportunities, and grow their business. By combining real-world healthcare data with AI-powered insights, AcuityMD enables companies from pre-commercial to enterprise to understand where and how to sell faster to accelerate the adoption of medical technology. AcuityMD ranked No. 316 on the 2026 Inc. 5000 list of the fastest-growing private companies in America and was named to Forbes’ 2025 “Next Billion-Dollar Startups” list – an elite group of 25 venture-backed U.S. companies identified as most likely to reach a $1 billion valuation.‍ AcuityMD is backed by Stepstone Group, Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, ICONIQ, and Atreides Management.

We are currently seeking a Data Program Manager to join our Product team and push forward our data products. In this role, you will be responsible for execution on acquiring data. This is primarily via AI driven curation work, building agents, evaluating quality, and ongoing systems to maintain them over time. You will also occasionally be responsible for acquiring new datasets with third parties. This will require close collaboration with peers on the product team to prioritize the right datasets, evaluate ROI and data quality, and ensure the business can make investment decisions correctly.

With empathy for how we collect, curate, and use data, you will use AI both at work and in our official data pipelines to help create and acquire datasets.

Team Mission

The AcuityMD platform features data from across the healthcare industry. Our data assets are the foundation of our application and central to the value we deliver to clients. The quality of our data is paramount for building trust with new clients and maintaining trust with existing clients. We operate in a field where we must constantly search for ground-truth data we can leverage to improve the quality of our product.

Responsibilities

  • Build AI agents to acquire new data, define the ways we measure data quality, identify where and how we can improve our data and processes.
  • Partner with the product teams to coordinate deployment of the data into the product for customers.
  • Help define KPIs on how we measure the quality of our datasets, tied to customer outcomes.
  • Execute on new data acquisition with third parties. Including but not limited to coordination, contracting process, and ensuring alignment to the business value.

Your Profile

  • 0-5 years of relevant experience (data analyst, light engineering, or otherwise)
  • You build empathy for customer problems and seek to understand, question, and improve the user experiences
  • A plus if you are familiar with some programming language - python, R, sql, or other scripting language.
  • A plus if you have experience engaging external vendors and going through discovery processes.
  • You’re exceptionally organized and can drive multiple projects forward simultaneously.
  • You’re comfortable with spreadsheets and structuring analyses and summaries out from them.
  • You seek hard problems to solve and are comfortable with ambiguity. You often structure your thinking in writing to sort through ambiguity.
  • You communicate clearly and concisely, can reason through tradeoffs, and tell stories using data
  • You have a bias towards action
  • You’re eager to learn new skills around building AI systems and roll up your sleeves to ensure they’re of high quality with evals.

AcuityMD is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, market data and may vary from the range provided. Base salary range: $85,000 - $125,000

You must have an eligible work permit in the USA to be considered for this position

We Offer:

  • Ground floor opportunity: Join a high-growth startup, backed by world-class investors across Enterprise SaaS and Medical Devices (Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, and Ajax Health).
  • Learning Budget: Reimbursements for relevant learning and up-skilling opportunities.
  • Remote work: AcuityMD is committed to supporting full-remote flexibility for employees in the US. We provide a work-from-home stipend for all employees.
  • Flexible PTO: Generous time off and flexible hours give you the freedom to do your best work.
  • Paid Health, Dental, and Vision Plans: We offer 100% paid health, dental, and vision plans for all employees and 75% paid for our employees' dependents.
  • Home Office Stipend: $1,000 to invest in remote office equipment and WiFi reimbursement.
  • Optional Team Retreats: We meet in-person multiple times per year for co-working and social gatherings.
  • Parental Leave: 8-16 weeks of fully-paid, flexible parental leave.

Who We Are:

The Company: We are builders, who are inspired by our mission to expand patient access to cutting-edge medical technologies. We value working collaboratively to solve hard problems for our customers with simple, innovative solutions. We push ourselves to learn with empathy. We foster an active culture of mentorship and inclusion, and we welcome new team members that share our values.

We're backed by Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, Ajax Health, and several other leading software and medical device investors. Since Acuity launched in 2020, we've brought on customers ranging from publicly traded Fortune 500 companies to innovative growth-stage companies and regional medical device distributors.

The Product: AcuityMD uses data and software to help teams collaborate around the complex relationships they have with the users of medical technologies: doctors. Our platform empowers medical technology companies to see how their products are used, understand why outcomes vary, and identify opportunities where physicians or sites of care can better serve their patients.

How We Work:

AcuityMD is a remote-first company. We believe the best talent isn't confined to one zip code, so our team works from wherever they do their best work, across the U.S.

We also believe some of our best work happens face-to-face. Critical projects move faster, our products get better, and our community gets stronger when we're in the same room, so we bring the team together throughout the year for company-wide and team on-sites built around that work.

In practice: expect 4-5 in-person opportunities a year through company/team on-sites and in-person collaboration for critical projects. If you're based near our Boston hub, there's no set requirement for how often you come into the office, that's your call, based on what works best for you and your team.

AcuityMD is an Equal Opportunity Employer

AcuityMD is seeking to create a diverse work environment because all teams are stronger with different perspectives and life experiences. We strongly encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. All employees and contractors of AcuityMD are responsible for maintaining a work culture free from discrimination and harassment by treating others with kindness and respect.

raw.excerpt: About Nerdio At Nerdio, our mission is to simplify the lives of IT professionals and maximize their Microsoft cloud and end user computing investments.
raw.description:
About Nerdio

At Nerdio, our mission is to simplify the lives of IT professionals and maximize their Microsoft cloud and end user computing investments.

We support organizations of all sizes looking to deploy, manage, and cost-optimize native Microsoft technologies. We partner with Enterprises and Managed Service Providers all over the world to add value on top of their existing native Microsoft investments like Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Windows 365, and Microsoft Intune.

Created in 2016, Nerdio has always taken a market-leading and collaborative approach to cloud deployment and management. In fact, our product roadmap is greatly influenced by the regular feedback we receive from having seen companies deploy AVD into production environments several thousand times using Nerdio technology.

Today, Nerdio is used in over 50 countries by more than 15,000 organizations of every size and vertical. We’re committed to delivering exceptional service and support, which starts with identifying and supporting the best staff possible.

We are a fast-moving, nimble company looking for individuals who are collaborative, empathetic, driven and who love to move at the speed of light. If you want to be part of the AVD transformation that Microsoft and Nerdio are leading, then we want to speak with you.

About the role

We are looking for a hands-on Controller to own the integrity, timeliness, and scalability of our accounting operations. Reporting to the VP, Accounting, you will lead the day-to-day close, manage our US and international audits, help us build a scalable pricing, packaging, and billing engine for our multi-channel business, serve as a senior technical accounting resource, and build the processes and team that keep us audit-ready year-round, not just at year-end. This is a role for someone with technical depth, sound business judgment, and a bias for building. We welcome both experienced Controllers and standout Assistant Controllers ready to step into their first Controller role.

What you'll do

Close & Financial Reporting

  • Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close, driving continuous reduction in close cycle time while maintaining accuracy
  • Review account reconciliations, journal entries, and flux analyses; ensure clean, GAAP-compliant financial statements
  • Prepare and review financial reporting packages for the board, PE sponsor, and lenders, including covenant compliance

Technical Accounting

  • Apply US GAAP to complex SaaS and usage-based transactions, including ASC 606 (revenue recognition), ASC 340-40 (capitalized commissions), ASC 718 (stock-based compensation), ASC 805 (business combinations), and ASC 842 (leases)
  • Account for revenue across our multi-channel business (direct, partner and reseller, and marketplace), including principal vs. agent, gross vs. net, and channel incentive considerations
  • Draft and maintain technical accounting memos and accounting policies
  • Evaluate the accounting impact of new contracts, pricing models, and strategic transactions, including M&A

Audit & Controls

  • Lead the consolidated US audit as primary liaison to our Big 4 auditor; manage PBC lists, timelines, and year-round audit readiness
  • Own audits at key international entities, including the UK and Germany
  • Design, document, and monitor internal controls with a SOX-readiness mindset and drive continuous improvement
  • Coordinate tax compliance with external advisors, including sales/use, income, and international

Global Payroll & Compliance

  • Review and ensure compliance for US payroll and international Employer of Record (EOR) services across all countries where Nerdio employs people

Team Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop the accounting team (GL, revenue, AP, payroll, and related functions)
  • Set clear expectations, build succession, and foster a culture of ownership and accountability

Systems & Process

  • Act as a champion for our finance tech stack (NetSuite, Ramp, FloQast), driving automation and efficiency
  • Identify and implement process improvements, including AI and automation tooling, to scale without proportional headcount

Pricing, Packaging & Billing

  • Be a key finance partner in building a nimble pricing, packaging, and billing solution that lets us launch and change offers quickly without breaking the close
  • Translate new pricing models and channel structures into scalable billing, revenue recognition, and reconciliation processes, working closely with Product, RevOps, and Systems teams
  • Ensure billing data flows accurately and consistently from each channel into NetSuite and the financial statements

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with FP&A, Revenue Operations, Legal, Sales Ops, and HR on forecasting, deal structures, and compensation accounting
  • Support finance integration for acquisitions and new entities
  • Contribute to the accuracy and understanding of SaaS metrics (ARR, NRR, churn) alongside GAAP results

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance
  • Active CPA license
  • 8+ years of progressive accounting experience, including 2-4 years in a Controller role, or a strong Assistant Controller / Accounting Manager ready for a first Controller role
  • Strong command of US GAAP, with demonstrated SaaS revenue recognition experience (ASC 606)
  • Experience managing and developing accounting teams and supporting external audits

raw.excerpt: Who We AreArrive Logistics is a leading transportation and technology company in North America with plans to grow significantly year over year.
raw.description:
Who We Are

Arrive Logistics is a leading transportation and technology company in North America with plans to grow significantly year over year. Our success is a testament to our remarkable team and what we’re building together. We’re committed to providing employees with a meaningful work experience and have established an award-winning culture that supports personal and career development in a fun, casual, and collaborative environment.

Who We Want

We want an analytical, self-driven, and detail-oriented Claims Analyst to join our growing Arrive Fresh division. You’ll own a portfolio of temperature-controlled and perishable cargo claims, protecting Arrive’s financial position while serving as a responsive, trusted partner to our customers and carriers. You bring hands-on claims experience and a working knowledge of cargo liability, PACA, and food safety rules, and you’re eager to deepen your cold-chain expertise. You move with urgency when perishable freight is at risk, communicate clearly under pressure, and know when to escalate. Your follow-through and collaborative approach will help Arrive Fresh scale and strengthen our reputation as a premier cold-chain partner.

What You'll Do

  • Manage an assigned portfolio of Arrive Fresh cargo claims from initial filing to final resolution, ensuring accurate, compliant, and timely outcomes.
  • Investigate and resolve temperature-controlled freight claims involving reefer temperature deviations, pulp readings, transit delays, shelf-life deterioration, and USDA inspection results, applying PACA guidelines and the Carmack Amendment.
  • Negotiate and settle cargo loss, damage, shortage, and contamination claims with shippers, receivers, carriers, and insurance adjusters within established authority levels.
  • Act quickly to mitigate losses on perishable freight by coordinating salvage, redistribution, or disposal in line with food safety and FSMA requirements.
  • Collect and validate claim documentation, including temperature logs, bills of lading, USDA inspections, and invoices, to build defensible positions for recovery and subrogation.
  • Reconcile claim-related receivables and payables, secure releases, and execute assignments of rights to maintain financial accuracy.
  • Track claims data and trends to flag risk areas, recurring issues, and carrier performance concerns, and share findings with Arrive Fresh leadership.
  • Partner with Carrier Sales, Business Delivery, Legal, and Operational Risk to address high-risk shipments and align on dispute resolution.
  • Escalate complex, high-value, or litigated claims to the Arrive Fresh Risk Manager with a clear summary and recommended path forward.
  • Monitor cold-chain compliance and carrier vetting standards for temperature-controlled freight, enforcing reefer unit certifications, temperature-recording protocols, pre-cooling requirements, and FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule compliance.
  • Oversee operational risk workflows for rejected, stranded, or high-risk perishable loads, coordinating real-time reefer temperature deviation reviews, offsite restacks, and carrier holds or decertifications to prevent financial loss.
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date claim records in the TMS and claims management system, and keep customers and carriers informed of claim status.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in a relevant field (Supply Chain, Business Administration, Finance, or related) or equivalent professional experience preferred.
  • 3+ years of cargo claims management experience, with a heavy emphasis on 3PL, freight brokerage, or cargo insurance environments.
  • Deep knowledge of perishable freight laws and standards, including the Carmack Amendment, PACA (Perishable Agricultural Commodities Act) guidelines, USDA standards, and FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act).
  • Strong negotiation, conflict resolution, and critical thinking skills, with a track record of handling high-value settlements and complex legal disputes.
  • Outstanding organizational skills and intensive attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced logistics environment.
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace, freight broker TMS platforms, and claims management software.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a focus on proactive, collaborative customer and carrier relationship management.

The Perks of Working With Us

  • Take advantage of our comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and supplemental coverage.
  • Invest in your future with our matching 401(k) program.
  • Build relationships and find your home at Arrive through our Employee Resource Groups.
  • Maximize your wellness with free counseling sessions through our Employee Assistance Program
  • Take time to manage your physical and mental health - we offer company paid holidays, paid vacation time and wellness days.
  • Receive 100% paid parental leave when you become a new parent.
  • Get paid to work with your friends through our Referral Program!

Your Arrive Experience

When we say “award-winning culture,” we mean it. We’ve been recognized as a top workplace by Inc. Fast Company, Fortune, and earned Top Workplaces and Great Place to Work, to name a few. We intend on topping many more of those lists in the years to come, but we’re not in it for the trophies. We’re committed to culture because it keeps us connected to each other and invested in our shared success while having a blast along the way. Our employee-founded resource groups create communities within Arrive’s walls, including Women in Logistics, Emerging Professionals, Prisms, Black Logistics Group, Salute and Unidos.

Notice:

To ensure a safe and transparent interview process, we want to note that Arrive Logistics adheres to strict recruitment practices. Candidates undergo an interview process, and Arrive Logistics does not provide unsolicited job offers. If you have concerns about receiving a fraudulent offer, please contact for verification.

raw.description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at .

What you’ll be part of:

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What you’ll be responsible for:

Circle is the issuer of USDC — the world's most widely used regulated dollar stablecoin — and is building the foundational infrastructure for an open global financial system. We're at an inflection point: USDC is moving from crypto-native rails to mainstream enterprise and sovereign payment flows, and we're structuring the inorganic strategy to match.

This Senior Director role sits at the center of that motion. You'll own working with our product and business colleagues to deeply understand the landscape and positioning to then evaluate, select, and lead the right deals — that means originating, evaluating, structuring, and closing acquisitions, strategic investments, and JVs that directly compound Circle's network position across payments, stablecoins, and institutional financial infrastructure.

What you’ll work on:

Deal Origination & Coverage

  • Maintaining a high-signal, always-on pipeline of acquisition targets, investment opportunities, and strategic partnership candidates — sourced from both your own network, collaboration with Circle colleagues, and inbound flow.

  • Staying genuinely plugged into what's happening in Bay Area fintech, payments, and AI — founders, fund managers, regulators, and operators — and translate those conversations into actionable strategic intelligence and deal flow for Circle leadership.

  • Running proactive build-vs-buy-vs-partner analyses grounded in Circle's strategic pillars, in particular Digital Assets and the emerging AI/agentic commerce stack.

End-to-End Deal Execution

  • Leading the full deal lifecycle: initial evaluation → diligence → structuring → negotiation → close → integration.

  • Coordinating and aligning cross-functional stakeholders (Legal, Finance, Product, Compliance, Engineering) through structured decision frameworks — you're the one keeping the train on the rails.

  • Writing crisp, recommendation-forward analysis, alignment, investment memos, and board materials that distill complex strategic trade-offs into clear risk and decision asks.

  • Structuring transactions that account for Circle's specific regulatory positioning, USDC liquidity dynamics, and multi-jurisdictional requirements.

Strategic Intelligence & Organizational Alignment

  • Developing a synthesized, current view of the competitive landscape: who the relevant players are, where they're headed, and what it means for Circle's inorganic priorities.

  • Translating market signals into organizational alignment — helping Circle leadership understand where and how to engage.

  • Mentoring and raise the bar for the broader CDV team on deal quality, process discipline, and strategic framing.

What you’ll bring to Circle:

Core Requirements:

  • 13+ years in corporate development, investment banking, growth equity, or strategic finance. You've led transactions end-to-end, not just supported them.

  • Deep, active network in fintech, payments, and/or crypto — with genuine relationships at the operator, founder, and fund level in the Bay Area. The kind of person who gets calls before a deal is public.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication. You can write a tight, decisive memo and present it credibly to a CEO or board.

  • Strong quantitative instincts — you build and stress-test financial models yourself, and you know where the bodies are buried in a cap table or income statement.

  • Familiarity with generative AI models (ChatGPT, Gemini, etc.) and prompt development.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Experience in crypto, stablecoins, digital assets, or regulated payments infrastructure — either as a practitioner or from deep coverage.

  • Track record closing deals in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where the deal thesis is still being written.

  • Familiarity with the AI ecosystem — both as an AI practitioner and someone who's in the room when AI infrastructure, fintech, and enterprise software deals are being discussed.

  • Experience working in or advising companies through regulatory complexity (FinCEN, OCC, international money transmission licensing).

  • Prior corporate development experience at a fintech, crypto-native firm, or large-cap tech company.

  • Bachelor’s degree required with an Economics, Finance, Business, Technology or related discipline preferred.

  • Experience/familiarity with Slack, Apple MacOS and GSuite.

Circle is on a mission to create an inclusive financial future, with transparency at our core. We consider a wide variety of elements when crafting our compensation ranges and total compensation packages.

Starting pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to: relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and other business and organizational needs. Please note that compensation ranges may differ for candidates in other locations.

raw.description:
About the team

At Zillow Home Loans, we’re at the forefront of revolutionizing the home financing experience. As part of Zillow Group’s FinTech division, you’ll help reshape how consumers buy, sell, and finance homes while working in a collaborative, high-energy environment. We’re a team of innovators, problem solvers, and creative individuals pushing the boundaries of the mortgage industry.

Mortgage Loan Officers at Zillow Home Loans, drive their success through one of two specialized lending teams.

One team leverages a high volume, lead driven, phone-based environment for Loan Officers who excel at high-frequency conversion and scaling customer relationships quickly.

The other team focuses on a consultative, market-based model for those who thrive on building long-term strategic partnerships with Zillow Preferred Agents.

Both teams are core to our purchase-focused mission and are equally backed by Zillow’s industry-leading technology, brand, centralized operations, and leadership support. Whether you find your edge in data-driven, lead-responsive execution or in nurturing a local professional network, both paths offer a high-impact career within the Zillow ecosystem.

About the role

This is an opportunity to grow your career as a purchase-focused Mortgage Loan Officeroriginating home loans for customers introduced through Zillow’s ecosystem. You’ll guide borrowers from first contact through funding while delivering a best-in-class customer experience. Based on your background and strengths, you may operate in either a high-volume, digitally driven environment or a relationship-based, market-focused model. Success in this role comes from responsiveness, execution, and performance in a structured, metrics-driven organization—supported by Zillow’s brand, platform, and operational scale.

This role is “remote” with restrictions. Your designated remote location is defined as your principal place of residence, which must be physically located within the state listed above South Dakota. You may also elect to spend some time working at a company office. Please note that your employment is contingent upon remaining in this location; any future requests to relocate to another state are subject to Company review and approval and may be denied based upon business need.

You Will Get To:

  • Originate and manage purchase mortgage loans from application through closing while ensuring compliance with all requirements.

  • Convert company-provided purchase opportunities into funded loans through proactive follow-up and effective borrower consultation.

  • Build strong relationships with customers and, where applicable, with Zillow Preferred Agents and local partners.

  • Manage an active pipeline while meeting defined service levels, productivity metrics, and funding expectations.

  • Leverage Zillow’s CRM, loan origination systems (LOS), and data-driven tools to manage pipeline health and customer engagement.

  • Partner with centralized processing, underwriting, and closing teams to move loans efficiently.

  • Deliver a consistent, high-quality customer experience through phone, email, and text communication.

  • Stay current on market trends, lending programs, and regulatory requirements to provide tailored financing solutions.

  • Maintain active licensing, complete required education, and participate in ongoing professional development.

  • This role involves the collection, storage, and use of your voiceprints (records of speech) for operational and compliance purposes.

In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance, and location.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • 3+ years of mortgage origination experience with a strong emphasis on purchase transactions, either as an active NMLS Loan Originator with state licenses or as a Loan Originator under a federal bank license.

  • Completion of the 20-hour CORE Pre-Licensing Education and successful passage of the SAFE Mortgage Loan Originator Test – National Component with Uniform State Content.

  • Physically located in and working remotely from South Dakota.

  • Proven success originating purchase loans in either: a high-volume, phone-based sales environment or an agent-centric referral model.

  • Strong client service orientation with consultative sales skills and deep understanding of the mortgage process.

  • Comfortable working in a structured, performance-driven environment with clearly defined KPIs.

  • Excellent verbal communication skills and ability to build trust quickly.

  • Strong time management, organization, and pipeline management skills.

  • Proficiency with CRM, LOS, and Microsoft products (Outlook, Word, Excel).

  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred.

Here at Zillow, we value the experience and perspective of candidates with non-traditional backgrounds and encourage you to apply if you bring transferable skills or related experience.

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.

Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Review this Doc first!

How to Prepare for the Recruiting Process -

📢 Why Are They Hiring an Operations Manager? 🏢

Our client is hiring an Operations Manager to act as the CEO's right-hand operator and the integrator across every arm of the business — Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Product. The company is scaling quickly, with multiple projects running at once, and the leadership team is currently wearing too many hats. They need someone who can connect the departments, track what's happening, enforce quality and SOPs, and make sure priorities actually move forward — without needing constant direction. Over time, this person will own onboarding, accountability, and operational coordination so the CEO can focus on vision, product, partnerships, and growth. This is not a 9-to-5 role; it's a high-trust, high-impact seat with a real path toward a COO-level role.

If you're a fast-moving, highly organized operator who thrives in startup energy, loves building structure out of chaos, and takes full ownership of results—this role could be a great fit for you. ✨

✅ Qualifications:

Must-Haves:

  • 🧭 Senior Operations Leadership in the Right Industry – You’ve worked as an Operations Manager, Integrator, COO, or Senior Operator at a fast-growing Software/SaaS, AI startup, info-product, coaching/education, or bootcamp/cohort/course business, or in a similar industry.
  • ⚡ Ultra-Fast Execution & Bias for Action– You think fast, act fast, and complete tasks in minutes—not hours—without needing hand-holding.
  • 🗂️ Exceptional Organization– Able to track and process hundreds of daily communications and moving parts without dropping details.
  • 📱 High Availability & Responsiveness– Comfortable with an extended workday, mobile responsiveness across time zones, and Saturday coverage.
  • 💪 Confident, Assertive Leadership– Comfortable following up, enforcing SOPs, holding people accountable, and resolving client disputes.
  • 🗣️ Excellent Spoken & Written English– Direct, clear, and confident on client-facing calls, video meetings, and written channels.
  • 🧠 Tech & CRM Literacy– You understand CRMs, automations, and AI tools well enough to manage technical team members (no coding required).
  • 🙌 No-Ego Mindset– Happy to switch between high-level operational leadership and hands-on executive assistance whenever the business needs it.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • 🎟️ Event & Cohort Experience– Prior experience running virtual or in-person cohort events, bootcamps, or masterminds.
  • 💬 High-Ticket Client Communications– Experience managing premium client communities on Slack and WhatsApp.
  • 🛂 Travel-Ready– A valid passport (and US visa) for potential occasional travel to US-based events.

Responsibilities of the Operations Manager:

Your responsibilities include:

🧭 Cross-Departmental Operations & Quality Control

  • Act as the CEO's right-hand operator, owning day-to-day execution across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Product
  • Work hands-on with department leads to keep teams, projects, and priorities aligned
  • Own and optimize company-wide SOPs, processes, and systems
  • Oversee setter and closer activity, monitoring responsiveness, speed-to-lead, and follow-up protocols
  • Enforce Customer Success SOPs and audit client response quality and resolution speed
  • Step in immediately when operational breakdowns happen—identify bottlenecks and fix them fast

💬 High-Volume Communication & Client Community Management

  • Monitor, organize, and process 500 to 1,000+ daily messages across internal channels and client groups
  • Oversee communications for 1,000+ high-ticket clients across multiple online communities
  • Stay responsive on Slack and WhatsApp (phone and laptop) across Australian and US time zones
  • Maintain clean tracking systems and notes so no client inquiry or action item is missed

🛡️ Executive Support & CEO Time Protection

  • Protect the CEO's time by taking routine troubleshooting, follow-ups, and coordination off her plate
  • Support the CEO with administrative and travel logistics, including flights, hotels, venue scouting, calendar alignment, and meeting notes
  • Call clients directly to resolve escalations and service disputes with confidence
  • Represent the brand on partnership, business development, and vendor calls—gathering intel and taking detailed notes

🎟️ Event, Bootcamp & Mastermind Logistics

  • Coordinate around 6 major events per year, including 3-day virtual bootcamps and in-person masterminds
  • Manage cohort schedules, attendee communications, onboarding, and workshop materials
  • Oversee end-to-end venue, catering, and attendee logistics for US-based luxury masterminds
  • Track participant accountability across workshops and cohorts
  • Travel to US-based events when required (frequency depends on location)

📊 KPIs, Performance & Team Accountability

  • Define, track, and optimize KPIs across all departments
  • Run weekly performance reviews and operational check-ins
  • Proactively follow up with team members throughout the day so nothing slips
  • Book calls immediately when team members are unresponsive or behind on deadlines
  • Use data to drive decisions, improvements, and prioritization

🤖 AI Systems, CRM & Workflow Management

  • Work inside the company's internal AI operating system—the central hub for project management, fulfillment, and reporting
  • Oversee operational data and customer journeys in GoHighLevel, Skool, Circle, and Wistia
  • Understand automation workflows (Zapier, Make.com, Claude, ChatGPT) well enough to manage technical team members and evaluate system health
  • Leverage AI to work faster—from organizing spreadsheets to building reports

🏗️ Systems Building & Future Scope

  • Build and refine client onboarding workflows, tracking systems, and accountability protocols

raw.description:
As the creator economy continues to expand, Flippa is at the forefront—offering a trusted, data-driven space for buying and selling YouTube channels. We're building the future of digital asset ownership, and we want you to be part of it.

We’re looking for a high-energy, curious, and motivated Sales Development Representative (SDR) to support the growth of Flippa’s YouTube Channels vertical. You’ll be the first point of contact for prospective sellers and buyers, helping them understand the value of the marketplace and guiding them toward high-quality transactions.

This role is perfect for someone who understands the power of digital media, loves discovering new creators, and is excited by the opportunity to work in a deal-driven, fast-paced environment.

This position is fully remote and will be based in Barcelona, Spain reporting to our YouTube Category Manager.

At Flippa, your ideas count and your perspective matters. We favour the brave and want you to do your best work. You will love it here if you are open and curious, love a fast pace, always think about the end customer and know the digital economy. We want to help our customers be successful and this means working on the things that matter most to them. We support each other (one of our values is to Be Human) to achieve great things and celebrate the wins. Do you want to Own Your Future?

As a Self Service Account Manager you will get to:

Be at the forefront of online business sales - connecting business owners with global buyers and helping them successfully exit.

Our Culture

Flippa offers a creative, solution-oriented culture of smart and nice people. You'll work with passionate colleagues, tackle challenging problems, and enjoy competitive remuneration.

  • Managing a portfolio of high-value digital assets and online businesses.
  • Guiding sellers through deal preparation, including reviewing and preparing P&Ls.
  • Consulting with interested buyers, drive negotiations, and close deals.
  • Acting as the singular point of contact for deal management, delivering a white-glove experience.
  • Prioritising active buyer interest (80%) while also supporting sellers (20%).
  • Tackling ad hoc projects that support strategic goals, internal initiatives, and continuous improvement.
  • Finance or accounting background (CA/CPA a plus).
  • Business brokerage, investment banking, or consulting experience with a revenue focus.
  • A strong sales mindset—proven success in hitting quotas or revenue targets.
  • Excellent communication skills—written, verbal, and interpersonal.
  • Strong analytical thinking and commercial instincts.
  • Tech comfort: proficient in HubSpot, Gmail, and Zoom.
  • Self-motivated, organised, and a natural relationship builder.
  • Resilient and adaptable—you’re excited by the pace and ambiguity of a startup.
  • Interest in digital assets, online products, and the future of entrepreneurship.

Are You a Fit?

  • You possess a Think, Say, Plan, Do mindset and demonstrate this in everything you do.
  • You are solutions-oriented.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced, ambitious environment.
  • You are results-driven with a positive attitude and a desire to “go the extra mile.”
  • You have loads of initiative and can work autonomously while collaborating across teams.
  • You love helping small business owners achieve their goals.
  • You want to have some fun while making a significant impact.

  • Ensures Therakos presents a unified face to the customer.

Role Title: Senior Mobile Software Engineer

Role Type: Contractor (~15 hrs a week)

Location: Remote

In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.

As an expert, you will create Reinforcement Learning Environments that test an AI model’s ability to solve complex mobile software engineering problems related to fixing code, creating features, refactoring code, and optimizing performance. You will be tasked with creating a reproducible environment and a golden reference solution for each problem.

Required Skills

  • Kotlin

  • Swift

  • Mobile

Scope of Work

  • Create realistic, interesting, and extremely challenging mobile coding tasks for frontier AI models using your preferred repositories.

  • Design problems that require strong mobile engineering skills, such as tracking down subtle bugs, building non-trivial features, handling application state and lifecycle, or improving performance.

  • Develop tasks relevant to your expertise: cross-platform applications using TypeScript, JavaScript, or Dart; iOS applications using Swift; or Android applications using Kotlin.

  • For each task, define the problem, build a reproducible environment, and write deterministic verifiers that accept correct solutions across different valid implementations while rejecting incorrect, incomplete, or hard-coded approaches.

  • Provide a reference solution showing how the task can be solved.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Significant hands-on expertise in at least one of the following mobile development tracks:

  • Cross-platform: TypeScript or JavaScript with React Native, or Dart with Flutter.

  • iOS: Swift with SwiftUI or UIKit.

  • Android: Kotlin with Jetpack Compose or the Android View system.

  • Deep understanding of mobile application architecture, state management, asynchronous programming, and application lifecycle.

  • Proven ability to debug complex mobile applications, resolve bugs, and deliver effective performance improvements.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum weekly submission requirements apply and will be communicated during onboarding.

Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within48 hoursand are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within24–48 hoursof completing onboarding.

Enterprise experience strongly preferred.

Key Responsibilities

  • Migrate pipelines from Apache Airflow 2 to Apache Airflow 3.
  • Migrate Confluent connections between cloud regions.
  • Migrate pipelines from Hive to Iceberg using Snowpark Connect.
  • Adapt existing data pipelines to Snowflake while maintaining data quality and reliability.
  • Support workflow scheduling and monitoring in Apache Airflow.
  • Partner with the team to execute time-sensitive data migrations.

Must-Have Skills

  • 2+ years of experience.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals.
  • Hands-on Python development experience.
  • Advanced SQL, including complex joins, CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning.
  • Snowflake data modeling.
  • Apache Airflow experience developing and testing pipelines in Airflow and Python.
  • Apache Kafka experience.
  • Apache Spark experience, including hands-on PySpark.
  • Experience with Iceberg and Parquet data formats.
  • AWS experience, particularly S3 data lakes, partitioning, and lifecycle policies.
  • Testing strategy experience and the ability to debug and test code hands-on.
  • At least 2 years of industry experience working with large-scale datasets, including Airflow and Spark.
  • Strong communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Hands-on Snowflake migration experience, including data warehouse modernization and performance and cost optimization.
  • Apache Airflow migration experience, including version upgrades, executor changes, or platform migrations.
  • Experience using AI tools for development.

Required Tools & Platforms

  • Python and SQL.
  • Snowflake, Apache Airflow, Apache Kafka, and Apache Spark/PySpark.
  • Iceberg and Parquet.
  • AWS S3.
  • The migration environment also includes Confluent, Hive, and Snowpark Connect.

Location, Time & Engagement

  • Open to candidates in eligible EMEA and APAC locations.
  • Coverage until 12:00 PM Pacific Time is required.
  • Remote contract engagement for 40 hours per week.

  • This is not currently a contract-to-hire opportunity.

The best practices for agentic platforms are being written right now, and you'll help write them.

What You'll Do

  • You will set the multi-year Agentic Platform strategy and turn it into a roadmap that balances reliability, speed for product teams, and bets on the frontier.
  • You will own core platform primitives — multi-agent orchestration, planning and execution runtimes, memory and context management, tool and MCP infrastructure, guardrails, and observability — and define the abstractions that let product teams compose new agents quickly.
  • You will lead the product side of custom model training and fine-tuning on ZoomInfo's proprietary data, deciding where custom models create lasting advantage versus frontier models.
  • You will build the decisioning-model layer that lets agents choose the right action, partnering with data science to turn ZoomInfo's signals into models agents invoke as first-class capabilities.
  • You will run a structured orchestration R&D program that tracks emerging research and moves the winners into production.
  • You will identify and ship net-new platform capabilities that unlock new product surfaces and revenue, taking ideas from whiteboard sketch to production primitive.
  • You will partner with engineering to make agent infrastructure production-grade — measurable on execution at scale, latency, cost per task, security, and compliance.
  • You will build and grow a team of senior and principal PMs, hiring for technical depth and ownership and developing leaders who run their own areas with the same bar you hold.

What You Bring

Must-Have:

  • At least 10 years building technical products, including at least 3 years leading teams of PMs or running a company
  • Deep, hands-on experience with production agentic systems — agents that plan, invoke tools, and take real actions, not just chat interfaces
  • A track record of taking an AI or agentic product from 0→1, either as a founder or as the product leader who owned it end to end
  • Fluency across the modern agentic stack, including orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, or custom), MCP and tool-calling patterns, RAG and memory architectures, and evals and observability
  • Enough technical depth to review architecture docs, read agent traces, and prototype in code yourself

Preferred:

  • Working knowledge of model development, including fine-tuning, post-training, evaluation design, and the economics of custom versus frontier models
  • Experience building platform products where engineering and product teams are your customers
  • Experience shipping decisioning, ranking, or recommendation models into production
  • Experience in B2B, GTM, or data platform businesses

At G-P, we assist organizations in building exceptional global teams in days, not months—streamlining the hiring, onboarding, and management process to unlock growth potential for all.

About the role:

As our customer base evolves to serve large global enterprises, we are shifting from fragmented, regional ops handoffs to a dedicated, high-touch delivery model.

The Forward Deployed Operations Manager (FD-OM) acts as the single operational point of contact for our enterprise clients and internal Customer Success teams. In this role, you will lead complex, multi-country onboarding implementations end-to-end. You will sit at the intersection of enterprise project management, global employment compliance, customer activation, and operational delivery—ensuring seamless global expansions and long-term customer satisfaction.

What you will do:
Enterprise Implementation & Project Management

  • End-to-End Onboarding: Own and project manage end-to-end, multi-country EOR onboarding programs from HR Operations’ perspective for enterprise clients, managing timelines, risk registers, and critical path milestones.
  • Single Point of Contact: Serve as the primary operational partner for enterprise Customer POCs, ensuring a coordinated and unified HR operations service delivery experience during project implementation,.
  • Internal Alignment: Coordinate within internal HR Ops regional teams in close partnership with Customer Success, Sales teams to align resources and streamline program execution

Global Compliance & Operational Delivery

  • Compliance Oversight: Navigate complex international labor laws, visa/immigration requirements, benefits administration, and localized employment contract - acting as a consultant to our Customers to deliver on value across multiple workstreams and tailor our offering to Customer’s needs
  • Local Ops Integration: Translate complex in-country operational nuances into clear action plans for the customer while maintaining strict adherence to local regulations.
  • Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify and resolve operational blockers, regulatory risks, and payroll setup delays across multiple jurisdictions.

Customer Relationship & Activation

  • Customer Success Partnership: Partner closely with assigned Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to bridge operational delivery with long-term strategic account growth.
  • Adoption & Happiness: Drive client activation and platform adoption, ensuring a white-glove onboarding experience for both enterprise admins and international employees.
  • Escalations & Problem-Solving: Act as the direct escalation point for complex operational inquiries, resolving issues with high speed and precision.

Operational Scaling & Process Improvement

  • Playbook Development: Document and refine implementation playbooks, scalable workflows, and enterprise delivery standards to continuously decrease time-to-first-payroll.
  • Voice of Customer: Partner with Product and Engineering teams to feed enterprise client requirements back into the platform roadmap.

What we’re looking for:Minimum requirements

  • Relevant Experience: 4+ years in Enterprise Implementation, Customer Onboarding, Technical Project Management, or Operations Delivery—ideally within the EOR, Payroll, Global HR Tech, or SaaS space.
  • Domain Knowledge: Direct exposure to global employment mechanics (Employer of Record, global payroll, employment law basics, or HR operations).
  • Enterprise Project Management: Proven track record of managing multi-stakeholder, multi-country projects using formal frameworks (PMP, Agile, or equivalent experience).
  • Client-Facing Presence: Excellent communication and consultative leadership skills; comfortable steering calls with VP/C-suite stakeholders at Fortune 500 or high-growth enterprise companies.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to thrive in ambiguous environments and translate complex regulatory/operational realities into simple, actionable steps for clients.

Preferred requirements

  • Experience handling complex, high-volume employee transfers (TUPE, M&A transitions, or enterprise-wide migrations).
  • International work experience across EMEA, LATAM, or APAC regions.

Core Competencies & KPIs

Core Competencies

  • Stakeholder Orchestration: Keeping clients, local ops, and CSMs aligned on timeline and scope.
  • Operational Agility: Unblocking localized compliance hurdles quickly without compromising governance.
  • Empathy & Drive: Delivering high customer satisfaction during high-stakes corporate expansions.

Success Metrics (KPIs)

  • Time-to-Activation / Speed-to-Onboard: Minimizing the cycle time from contract signing to employee active state.
  • Customer Satisfaction (CSAT / NPS): High satisfaction scores during the onboarding and implementation phase.
  • Implementation Accuracy: Zero compliance or payroll setup errors during the first pay run.
  • Account Retention & Expansion Readiness: Smooth handoff to CSMs with fully activated platform usage.

Job Title: Field Medical Operations Lead, Rhino/Gastro/Allergy, US Medical Immunology

Our Sanofi Immunology Medical Affairs function serves as a valued strategic partner with Clinical, Commercial, Regulatory, and Market Access on therapeutic solutions to support patients’ needs. The US Medical Immunology team is proud to support Sanofi’s deep commitment to chasing the miracles of science to improve the lives of patients. We shatter treatment inertia through our commitment to leaving no Type 2 inflammation patient behind. We aim to transform medical practice, deliver innovative and actionable data to providers and payers enabling timely patient identification and driving the urgency to act on debilitating immunological disorders.

The Field Medical Operations Lead, RGA, will report to the Medical Operations Director and will work with the respective US Medical Immunology Franchise team to provide operational support for various medical activities and programs.  This individual will collaborate with both internal and external stakeholders to facilitate the timely execution of various launch activities including management of budget, tools, processes, and reporting.  

The Operations Lead will work together with alliance and franchise counterparts to ensure alignment of various medical activities (advisory boards, core team meetings, communications, budget tracking, medical planning activities, field medical systems/reporting etc) to ensure timely execution of the medical plan in a cost-efficient manner.

In addition, this individual will support project management and pull through for relevant global cross-GBU initiatives. This position will also identify and support process improvement and general project management to ensure successful completion of projects/initiatives according to timelines and associated budgets.

Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you'll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

Travel: Ability to travel up to 15% of the time to participate on external meetings and trainings, and other internal meetings.

About Sanofi:

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Support launch excellence by tracking key launch-related activities to ensure timely execution; identify/recommend/support process improvement opportunities; develop KPI-related reports to communicate status of critical deliverables.
  • Provide day-to-day oversight and support for key systems and process, working with relevant internal stakeholders and external vendors (e.g., SharePoint, Smartsheet, TEAMS).

  • Implement & manage portfolio & operational level activities via harmonized tools/systems.
  • Support the development of an integrated Medical Plan by coordinating meetings and communications; collaborating with Alliance and Franchise counterparts as well as key stakeholders to ensure consistent alignment of program activities and tactical execution.
  • Provide guidance to internal/external partners regarding business-related initiatives to ensure workflow and processes are efficient and compliant with internal SOPs and external guidelines.
  • Build and maintain strong and collaborative partnerships with internal and external parties; serve as an advocate for the overall collaboration with key stakeholders.
  • Point of contact to triage Veeva CRM and other field operating system issues
  • Process field content/materials through the MMRC approval process
  • Upload approved materials into Veeva CLM

About You:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree with minimum of 5 years of total professional experience, including project/program management experience supporting and leading cross-functional teams.
  • Experience using Smartsheet, Excel, project management systems/tools, and process improvement methodology are highly desirable.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Industry/pharma or biopharma experience is strongly desired.
  • Strong planning and tracking skills, well-organized, focused on results, capable of managing multiple projects with respect to priorities and self-management.
  • In-depth knowledge of medical organizations including related operating processes, systems, policies, procedures and regulations.
  • A strong working knowledge of business processes and systems, including medical activity planning and budgeting, is highly desirable.
  • Exceptional communication skills, both oral and written, excellent organizational time management skills, and the ability to lead, collaborate and align with diverse, cross-functional matrix teams.
  • Understanding of pharmaceutical or biotechnical regulated environments and functions
  • Analytical and detail oriented, well developed organizational skills, pragmatic in solving problems

Additional Professional Skills:

  • Ability to lead project management initiatives and process improvement
  • Ability to champion change initiatives, promote innovation, and implement new approaches
  • Ability to conduct effective meetings

  • Technology savvy; familiar with information systems, CRM platforms, and IT resources
  • Fluent in Excel, PowerPoint, Smartsheet, SharePoint

  • Proactive, self-starter attitude
