raw.description:
Why Charlie Health?

Millions of people across the country are navigating mental health conditions, substance use disorders, and eating disorders, but too often, they’re met with barriers to care. From limited local options and long wait times to treatment that lacks personalization, behavioral healthcare can leave people feeling unseen and unsupported.

Charlie Health exists to change that. Our mission is to connect the world to life-saving behavioral health treatment. We deliver personalized, virtual care rooted in connection—between clients and clinicians, care teams, loved ones, and the communities that support them. By focusing on people with complex needs, we’re expanding access to meaningful care and driving better outcomes from the comfort of home.

As a rapidly growing organization, we're reaching more communities every day and building a team that’s redefining what behavioral health treatment can look like. If you're ready to use your skills to drive lasting change and help more people access the care they deserve, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

Charlie Health is one of the fastest-growing startups in the healthcare industry, working tirelessly to connect people everywhere to life-saving mental health and substance use treatment.

As a SUD Referral Relations Specialist, you will join a founding go-to-market team responsible for scaling Charlie Health's Substance Use Disorder (SUD) program nationally. SUD represents our next major growth vertical, and this team is charged with building the playbook. Where our Outreach team builds the relationships that point people toward care, you will make sure they get there.

Connecting someone with a substance use concern to treatment takes more than a warm handoff. Clients often come to us in crisis, in unstable circumstances, and at the hardest possible moment to keep an appointment. You will own the daily work of making sure no one is lost in that gap — identifying clients whose care has stalled, reaching out directly to get them rescheduled, coordinating with our Admissions team, and keeping referral partners informed on every client they send us.

You will work shoulder to shoulder with our SUD-focused Outreach Team and Admissions team.

This role is best suited for someone who thrives in high-accountability environments and wants to help build something meaningful from the ground up. In your role, you'll have unparalleled responsibility while collaborating with sharp, spirited, and ambitious coworkers. You'll also receive competitive benefits, ensuring you have the resources to thrive both personally and professionally.

We’re a team of passionate, forward-thinking professionals eager to take on the challenge of the mental health crisis and play a formative role in providing life-saving solutions. If you’re inspired by our mission and energized by the opportunity to increase access to mental healthcare and impact millions of lives in a profound way, apply today.

Responsibilities

  • Own the client journey from first contact through the start of care, making sure no one falls out of the process along the way
  • Serve as the connective tissue between referral partners, clients, and our Admissions team
  • Keep referral partners closely informed on the people they entrust to us, building confidence in Charlie Health as a long-term care partner
  • Partner with our Outreach team to keep every client moving toward treatment, and coach on pipeline strategy so their time stays focused in the field
  • Identify barriers to care as they surface and escalate the patterns behind them

Requirements

  • Experience in direct client-facing role (e.g. Admissions Team), particularly in the mental health field, preferred.
  • Support pipeline management activities during key Central Time and West Coast time hours (11am to 7pm ET).
  • Work authorized in the United States and native or bilingual English proficiency
  • Familiarity with and willingness to use cloud-based communication software—Google Suite, Slack, Zoom, Dropbox, Salesforce–in addition to EMR and survey software on a daily basis.

Benefits

Charlie Health is pleased to offer comprehensive benefits to all full-time, exempt employees. Read more about our benefits here.

Additional Information

The total target base compensation for this role will be between $55,000 and $65,000 per year at the commencement of employment. In addition to base compensation, this role also offers a performance bonus. The expected total cash compensation range, including potential bonus, will be between $71,500 and $84,000 per year. Please note, pay will be determined on an individualized basis and will be impacted by location, experience, expertise, internal pay equity, and other relevant business considerations. Further, cash compensation is only part of the total compensation package, which, depending on the position, may include stock options and other Charlie Health-sponsored benefits.

HYBRI

Our Values

  • Connection: Care deeply & inspire hope.
  • Congruence: Stay curious & heed the evidence.
  • Commitment: Act with urgency & don’t give up.

Please do not call our public clinical admissions line in regard to this or any other job posting.

Please be cautious of potential recruitment fraud. If you are interested in exploring opportunities at Charlie Health, please go directly to our Careers Page: Charlie Health will never ask you to pay a fee or download software as part of the interview process with our company. In addition, Charlie Health will not ask for your personal banking information until you have signed an offer of employment and completed onboarding paperwork that is provided by our People Operations team. Being an Equal Opportunity Employer means every member of our team feels as though they are supported and belong. PBM® empowers employees to be entrepreneurial, to innovate, and to continually drive transformation.

Job Title: (Associate) Director, Medical Liaison - North Central USA

Job Location: Remote, Indiana, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


Overview

Centessa Pharmaceuticals, a wholly owned subsidiary of Eli Lilly and Company, is a clinical-stage company developing orexin receptor 2 (OX2R) agonists as a new class of medicines for the treatment of narcolepsy and potentially other sleep-wake disorders. Centessa’s lead investigational candidate – cleminorexton (formerly ORX750) – is being developed for narcolepsy type 1, narcolepsy type 2, and idiopathic hypersomnia. Centessa's OX2R agonist portfolio includes additional clinical and preclinical-stage assets with potential utility across a broader range of neurological, neurodegenerative, and neuropsychiatric conditions.Headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, Centessa was recognized as a Great Place to Work® in 2026.

The MSL will serve as a field-based scientific expert responsible for engaging with healthcare professionals (HCPs), supporting clinical development, and ensuring alignment with Centessa’s strategic medical objectives. This role is critical in translating complex scientific data into meaningful clinical insights and fostering compliant, evidence-based dialogue with thought leaders.

Responsibilities

Scientific Expertise & Thought Leader Engagement

  • Maintain a high level of therapeutic area expertise and scientific knowledge relevant to Centessa’s pipeline and marketed products in alignment with Medical Affairs strategic objectives

  • Engage in compliant, non-promotional scientific exchange with key opinion leaders (KOLs), investigators, and other HCPs

  • Serve as a trusted scientific resource to external stakeholders, providing accurate and balanced medical information

  • Deliver company-approved, high-quality medical/scientific presentations to a variety of audiences including formulary committees and healthcare professionals.

  • Provide medical/scientific support for critical Centessa activities including speaker training, advisory boards, and sales training as appropriate

  • Ensure accurate, timely, and compliant documentation of field-based activities in accordance with MSL organization guidelines

Clinical Trials Support

  • Collaborate with Clinical Operations to identify and evaluate potential clinical trial sites and investigators based on scientific expertise, patient population, and alignment with study objectives

  • Provide scientific education and protocol-specific training to investigators and site staff during site initiation visits, ensuring thorough understanding of study rationale and endpoints

Medical Conference Attendance & Coverage

  • Attend relevant scientific and medical congresses to stay current with emerging data and trends

Scientific Materials Development

  • Contribute to the development of scientific slide decks, FAQs, and educational materials

Basic Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (PhD, PharmD, MD) in life sciences or a related field (from An Accredited College or University).

  • Excellent understanding of sleep medicine and associated therapeutic areas strongly preferred

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; ability to tailor scientific messages to diverse audiences and ability to interpret and communicate complex scientific data

  • Proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships with KOLs, investigators, and internal stakeholders

  • Strong understanding of clinical trial design, regulatory requirements, and therapeutic area landscape

  • Skilled in developing and delivering scientific presentations in various settings

  • Strong understanding of industry regulations and guidelines governing medical interactions

  • Ability to align field activities with broader medical and corporate strategies

  • Must have a valid driver’s license with a driving record that meets company requirements

  • Willing and able to travel frequently throughout the North Central territory, including Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Michigan, Montana, Nebraska, North Dakota, South Dakota, Wisconsin, Wyoming, with primary coverage of major metropolitan and academic medical center markets across the region.

  • Must reside in the Chicago metropolitan area or, alternatively, in a major metropolitan area within the North Central territory with convenient access to a major commercial airport to support frequent travel throughout the region.

As an Enterprise Customer Success Manager, you will own the relationship with a book of business containing our most strategic customers, and you will be responsible for adoption, retention, expansion and driving NRR within your book of business. Our ideal candidate will possess strong negotiation and consultative selling skills as well as experience in identifying customer needs, delivering value and managing enterprise relationships across many different stakeholders, including executives.

What You’ll Do

  • Manage our most strategic and complex accounts by building and maintaining strong and lasting relationships with decision makers and key stakeholders within client organizations while achieving upsell and expansion revenue targets through the use of consultative selling techniques
  • Maintain a thorough understanding of customer status, satisfaction, business condition, business projections, business requirements, personnel and leadership changes, system configuration, partner relationships, etc.
  • Investigate account’s organizational landscape and build relationships that expand our footprint and drive revenue
  • Lead strategic program development to plan for clients’ success, including project plan development and communication internally and externally on progress
  • Manage client expectations, assessing needs and determining levels of adoption of the Unanet platform across client project teams
  • Identify new revenue opportunities and drive increased engagement for new and existing clients
  • Provide best practices, coaching and training to customers to help them maximize value of working with Unanet
  • Leverage domain and product knowledge to drive adoption and expansion opportunities
  • Forecast and communicate at-risk customers and define retention strategies
  • Prioritize customer requests to maintain a high degree of confidence and trust
  • Coordinate and manage commitments cross-functionally, leveraging subject matter experts to support customer requests
  • Provide updates and follow-ups to customers on outstanding issues, requests, and escalations
  • Coordinate regular account reviews, gathering and presenting status of customer goals, issues, and roadmap requests; produce reports that include data supporting the value delivered through utilization
  • Document and drive success plans for each customer
  • Create advocates by ensuring customers achieve goals identified in success plans
  • Develop creative solutions to support complex customer requirements
  • Effectively multitask and manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Mentor newer team members helping to drive a customer-centric attitude in the Customer Success team and the wider organization
  • Handle complex requests and nuanced situations with extreme professionalism, quick execution, and a sense of urgency to uphold our reputation for excellent customer service

Your First 90 Days

First 30 Days: Immerse yourself in our Customer Success methodologies, product offerings, and internal processes. Build strong relationships with cross-functional stakeholders and begin engaging with the customers within your assigned book of business. Gain familiarity with Unanet’s customer health metrics, and complete the Customer Success onboarding program.

Within 60 Days: Establish relationships within your book of business and understand key customer success metrics. Proactively assess customer health, identify initial expansion opportunities, and begin building strategic account plans.

Within 90 Days: Confidently lead customer calls, facilitating value-based discussions and presenting actionable insights. Proactively manage at-risk customers, identify upsell opportunities, and ensure customers are progressing toward desired outcomes with strategic account plans in place.

Who You Are

  • 8+ years of experience in Customer Success or Account Management in a B2B SaaS environment
  • 5+ years of experience managing enterprise or strategic accounts
  • Proven experience managing complex customer relationships, including C-level executives, to drive adoption, renewals, and expansion
  • Experience working with executives, both internally and externally; comfortable owning the room and facilitating meetings and strategy sessions with several departments and stakeholders
  • Proactive and strategic thinker, capable of identifying upsell opportunities and mitigating risks early in the customer lifecycle
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills with a strong ability to influence and build rapport
  • A self-starter who is comfortable working in a fast-paced and rapidly growing SaaS company with a focus on proactive problem-solving
  • Ability to effectively collaborate cross-functionally, including with remote teams
  • Proficient with Salesforce and other Customer Success platforms (e.g., ChurnZero, Gainsight)
  • Strong organizational and strategic planning abilities, with a focus on upsell and expansion strategies
  • Ability to travel 25-30%
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred, but relevant experience will be considered in lieu of a degree

Differentiators

  • Experience in the Architecture, Engineering & Construction (AEC) vertical, with an understanding of its unique challenges and opportunities
  • Prior experience with ERP and/or CRM solutions

Our Values

  • We are a Team. Employees, customers, and partners working together.
  • We are Customer-Focused. Customers are the heart of everything we do.
  • We are Driven. Seeking exceptional outcomes.
  • We Own our Success. Every employee has a stake in our company.
  • We do the right thing and have fun in the process.

The salary range for this opportunity is $116,450 – $141,750 per year. You will be eligible to earn commissions subject to commission plans and policies that may be in effect from time to time. You will further be eligible for employee equity as well as to participate in Unanet's employee benefits plans and programs. For more details on Unanet's benefits offerings, please visit .

Behavioral Health Utilization Management Clinician

Work from home within Oregon, Washington, Idaho or Utah

Preference will be given to current employees and candidates who reside in Idaho and Utah


Build a career with purpose. Join our Cause to create a person-focused and economically sustainable health care system.


Who We Are Looking For:


Every day, Cambia’s dedicated team of Clinicians are living our mission to make health care easier and lives better. As a member of the Behavioral Health team, our Clinicians provide utilization management (such as prospective concurrent and retrospective review) to best meet the member’s specific healthcare needs and to promote quality and cost-effective outcomes and appropriate payment for services – all in service of making our members’ health journeys easier.


Are you a licensed Clinician with a passion for Utilization Management wanting to make a career change? Are you wanting to make positive change in people's lives and healthcare? Then this role may be the perfect fit.


What You Bring to Cambia:

Qualifications:


  • Master’s Degree in Behavioral Health Discipline
  • 3 years of utilization management or behavioral health care management experience
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience
  • 3 years direct Behavioral Health clinical experience as an independently licensed Master's level Behavioral Health Clinician in one of the areas of Psychology, Counselling, Social Work, Marriage or Family Therapy
  • Clinical License must be unrestricted and current in state of residence. Must be licensed in WA, OR, ID or UT and willing to be licensed in multiple states

Skills and Attributes:


  • Proficiency in advanced behavioral healthcare settings, including inpatient hospitals, residential facilities, and partial hospital programs
  • Staying abreast of the latest developments in the health insurance industry, including trends, technological advancements, and contractual agreements
  • Proficient in general computer skills, including Microsoft Office, Outlook, and internet search capabilities
  • Familiarity with electronic healthcare documentation systems and their applications
  • Possessing exceptional verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, with a strong focus on customer service and support
  • Ability to accurately interpret and effectively communicate complex policies and procedures to various stakeholders
  • Demonstrating strong organizational and time management skills, with the capacity to manage workload independently and prioritize tasks efficiently
  • Possessing critical thinking skills, with the ability to make informed decisions within the scope of individual role and responsibility

What You Will Do at Cambia:


  • Performs comprehensive utilization management reviews, encompassing prospective, concurrent, and retrospective assessments, to ensure adherence to medical necessity and policy standards.
  • Applies clinical expertise and evidence-based criteria to make informed determinations, consulting with physician advisors as necessary to ensure accuracy.
  • Fosters collaboration with interdisciplinary teams, case management, and other departments to facilitate seamless transitions of care and resolve issues in a timely and effective manner.
  • Serves as a trusted resource, providing prompt and accurate responses to internal and external inquiries, ensuring exceptional customer service.
  • Identifies opportunities for improvement and actively participates in quality improvement initiatives to drive excellence.
  • Maintains meticulous and consistent documentation, prioritizing assignments to meet performance standards and corporate objectives.
  • Upholds the confidentiality of sensitive information and communicates professionally with members, providers, and regulatory organizations, ensuring data protection and integrity.

Pay ranges vary based on the candidate's work location. The expected hiring range depends on skills, experience, education, and training; relevant licensure / certifications; and performance history.


  • Oregon, Washington, Utah, and Idaho: The expected hiring range is $36.80 – $49.80 an hour, the full salary range is $34.20 – $55.70 an hour and the bonus target is 8%.
  • North Dakota: The expected hiring range is $35.21 - $47.63 an hour and the full salary range is $31.86 - $50.98 an hour.

About Cambia


Working at Cambia means being part of a purpose-driven, award-winning culture built on trust and innovation anchored in our 100+ year history. Our caring and supportive colleagues are some of the best and brightest in the industry, innovating together toward sustainable, person-focused health care. Whether we're helping members, lending a hand to a colleague or volunteering in our communities, our compassion, empathy and team spirit always shine through.


Why Join the Cambia Team?


At Cambia, you can:

  • Work alongside diverse teams building cutting-edge solutions to transform health care.
  • Earn a competitive salary and enjoy generous benefits while doing work that changes lives.
  • Grow your career with a company committed to helping you succeed.
  • Give back to your community by participating in Cambia-supported outreach programs.
  • Connect with colleagues who share similar interests and backgrounds through our employee resource groups.

We believe a career at Cambia is more than just a paycheck – and your compensation should be too. Our compensation package includes competitive base pay as well as a market-leading 401(k) with a significant company match, bonus opportunities and more.


In exchange for helping members live healthy lives, we offer benefits that empower you to do the same. Just a few highlights include:


  • Medical, dental and vision coverage for employees and their eligible family members, including mental health benefits.
  • Annual employer contribution to a health savings account.
  • Generous paid time off varying by role and tenure in addition to 10 company-paid holidays.
  • Market-leading retirement plan including a company match on employee 401(k) contributions, with a potential discretionary contribution based on company performance (no vesting period).
  • Up to 12 weeks of paid parental time off (eligibility requires 12 months of continuous service with Cambia immediately preceding leave).
  • Award-winning wellness programs that reward you for participation.
  • Employee Assistance Fund for those in need.
  • Commute and parking benefits.

Learn more about our benefits.


We are happy to offer work from home options for most of our roles. To take advantage of this flexible option, we require employees to have a wired internet connection that is not satellite or cellular and internet service with a minimum upload speed of 5Mb and a minimum download speed of 10 Mb.


As part of our security requirements, new hires will need access to a personal mobile device to set up Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) upon joining the company. MFA is an important layer of protection for accessing Cambia systems and is required for all employees.

We are an Equal Opportunity employer dedicated to a drug and tobacco-free workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status or any other status protected by law. A background check is required.

The Opportunity

The Director, Digital Marketing Strategist will lead the digital marketing strategy and operating model across Praxis’ Developmental and Epileptic Encephalopathy (DEE) and Movement Disorder portfolios. This leader will define the digital vision, channel roadmap, and priorities across the portfolio and partner closely with functional marketing leaders to ensure digital capabilities are built and deployed in service of brand and business objectives.

This role will sit at the intersection of strategy, technology, and execution. The Director will connect brand priorities with website, digital media, CRM, marketing technology, and broader digital capabilities, while coordinating closely with Commercial Excellence, Digital/IT, and agency partners to create a consistent, scalable, and high-quality digital experience across the portfolio.

This is a highly cross-functional leadership role for a builder who can establish clear digital strategy, simplify complexity, align stakeholders, and turn business priorities into disciplined execution.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead the portfolio digital marketing strategy and channel roadmap across DEE and Movement Disorder, establishing priorities, sequencing investments, and defining the capabilities needed to support near- and long-term business objectives.
  • Partner with functional marketing leaders to translate brand strategy into digital priorities, ensuring website, digital media, CRM, and marketing technology initiatives are aligned to audience needs, brand objectives, and the broader commercial strategy.
  • Establish the digital operating model across the portfolio, clarifying ownership, decision rights, ways of working, and standards to enable efficient collaboration across Marketing, Commercial Excellence, Digital/IT, and external partners.
  • Drive cross-functional prioritization and execution, serving as the connective tissue between commercial strategy and the teams responsible for digital products, platforms, data, technology, and activation.
  • Coordinate with Commercial Excellence Engineers, Digital/IT, and agency partners to ensure consistent digital execution, strong technical delivery, and a cohesive customer experience across the portfolio.
  • Define and advance the digital capability roadmap, identifying opportunities to strengthen personalization, measurement, CRM, marketing technology, data utilization, and other capabilities that improve the effectiveness of digital marketing.
  • Establish measurement and performance expectations for digital marketing, ensuring teams have clear objectives, meaningful KPIs, and actionable insights to continuously improve digital effectiveness.
  • Build scalable standards and best practices across brands and audiences, balancing portfolio consistency with the distinct needs of DEE and Movement Disorder.
  • Lead through influence across a highly matrixed organization, bringing clarity to complex decisions, challenging assumptions, and creating alignment without relying on formal authority.

Qualifications and Key Success Factors

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree in marketing, business, technology, or a related field is a plus.
  • Significant experience leading digital marketing strategy within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, or another highly regulated environment. Experience in CNS, rare disease and large market is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience developing portfolio-level digital strategies and translating them into channel roadmaps, investment priorities, and execution plans.
  • Deep understanding of digital marketing ecosystems, including websites, digital media, CRM, marketing technology, data, analytics, and agency models.
  • Experience partnering effectively with business, technology, commercial operations, and external agency teams to deliver complex digital initiatives.
  • Strong strategic and operational leadership skills, with the ability to move fluidly between long-term capability building and near-term execution.
  • Proven ability to lead through influence, align senior stakeholders, and create clarity across complex cross-functional environments.
  • Strong commercial judgment and customer orientation, with an ability to connect digital activity to meaningful business and customer outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to build processes, capabilities, and teams in a rapidly evolving environment.
  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex digital and technology concepts for diverse stakeholders.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset, high ownership, and comfort operating with ambiguity and urgency.
  • The physical and mental requirements of our roles include but are not limited to regular use of a computer, devices or other office equipment, clear communication, and occasional movement. You'll need comfort with screen work, basic hand coordination, and focus. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

raw.title: Senior Strategic Events Manager
raw.excerpt: About the RoleAbnormal is growing fast, and the way we show up in the world has to keep pace.
raw.description:
About the Role

Abnormal is growing fast, and the way we show up in the world has to keep pace. Our events are where our story becomes an experience—bringing customers, prospects, partners, and security leaders closer to our brand, our products, and our people.

Our owned events give us the opportunity to set the agenda and create experiences that bring Abnormal’s story to life. Our executive programs create space for the world’s most influential security leaders to engage directly with our leadership, our product, and one another. And at key third-party events, we meet the security community on its own turf—turning moments of engagement into meaningful relationships.

As Senior Strategic Events Manager, you’ll play a leading role in bringing these experiences to life, with a primary focus on Abnormal’s owned, executive, and internal events, while also supporting select high-impact third-party programs.

You’ll own end-to-end delivery across a diverse portfolio—from summits, roadshows, customer programs, and executive experiences to internal events and major industry moments. You’ll translate our broader event strategy into exceptional programs: shaping agendas and experiences, managing budgets and vendors, coordinating cross-functional teams, and leading execution on the ground to ensure every detail lands.

This is a hands-on IC role for someone who thinks like a strategist and executes like an owner. You'll have a portfolio, a budget, a set of very high standards, and the autonomy to go build. As Abnormal’s event portfolio continues to grow, so will the scope of this role—with a clear path toward greater strategic ownership of our owned, executive, and internal event portfolio.

What You'll Own

First-Party & Third-Party Events

  • Lead end-to-end planning and execution of some of Abnormal's key strategic events — from strategy and budget through delivery, measurement, and post-event analysis.
  • Own every component that makes an owned event work: venue and vendor selection, production, registration and attendee journey, hospitality, staffing, technology, and on-site operations — partnering with Brand Creative, Content, and Comms on creative, branding, and agenda.
  • Build the run-of-show, the project plan, the timeline, and the contingency plan — then run the room.
  • Partner with Sales, Strategic Alliances, Campaigns, Field Marketing, Product Marketing, and others to make sure every event is engineered for pipeline and customer engagement, not just attendance.
  • Manage budgets, contracts, POs, and vendor deliverables with real rigor. Know where every dollar went and what it returned.
  • Develop repeatable playbooks, templates, and standards so the portfolio scales without losing quality.
  • Act as the event's point of contact for your programs — the person stakeholders trust to have it handled.
  • Anticipate risk, escalate early and appropriately, and keep programs on track when priorities shift. They will shift.

Executive Experiences

  • Design and deliver premium executive programs: advisory boards, curated hospitality, and the executive tracks inside our larger events.
  • Bring hospitality-grade instincts to a B2B environment — anticipatory, service-minded, and unwilling to let a detail slide — paired with the resourcefulness to build it yourself when there's no playbook yet.
  • Make sure every touchpoint in the executive journey is intentional, frictionless, and elevated. From the invitation to the follow-up.
  • Collaborate with our executive team, internal SMEs, and Product Marketing to build agendas and content that give C-level audiences genuine insight, not a product demo in a nicer room.
  • Coordinate executive and VIP participation end to end — briefing materials, prep, on-site handling, and thoughtful follow-through.
  • Represent Abnormal directly to senior customer executives and their teams with professionalism, situational awareness, and a premium service mindset. You are an ambassador of this brand at the highest levels.

Large Internal Events

  • Co-own the planning and delivery of Abnormal's largest internal moments — Sales Kickoff and President’s Club.
  • Partner with Sales, Revenue Marketing, and People to define objectives, build the agenda, and manage production, venue, travel, and on-site operations.
  • Treat our own people with the same experience standard we give customers. The internal moments are where culture gets made, and they deserve the same craft as the external ones.

Measurement & Impact

  • Define and track KPIs for every program: attendance, engagement, meetings, pipeline influence, customer participation, and ROI.
  • Deliver post-event reporting with real recommendations — what we repeat, what we kill, what we invest more in.
  • Use data and stakeholder feedback to continuously sharpen strategy, investment, and execution.
  • Keep event documentation and reporting accurate and accessible across the portfolio.

What You Bring

  • 7+ years in strategic events, executive programs, or field marketing — including direct experience owning executive-level programs. Ideally in B2B technology, cybersecurity, SaaS, or another high-growth environment.
  • Proven ownership of complex, high-visibility owned events and executive programs from strategy through execution and analysis.
  • A premium experience mindset. You're obsessive about details, operationally excellent, and you build moments that people remember.
  • Strong program management chops: organized, proactive, structured, relentless about deadlines, and genuinely good at driving cross-functional work to an outcome.
  • Experience delivering large internal events such as Sales Kickoff, sales incentive or club trips, or company offsites.
  • Real budget, vendor, agency, and contract management experience across multiple concurrent workstreams.
  • Exceptional communication skills — polished agendas, briefing docs, and executive-facing comms that need no cleanup.
  • Executive maturity. You're comfortable and credible in a room full of senior leaders, internal or customer-side.
  • Composure under pressure. You can build the plan months out and solve the unexpected problem on-site in four minutes.
  • Commercially minded. You understand how events drive brand, customer relationships, and pipeline — and you make decisions accordingly.
  • Demonstrated use of AI to improve how you work: streamlining workflows, sharpening decisions, and creating leverage. We're an AI-native company and we expect our team to work like one.
  • Willingness to travel roughly 25%, primarily in North America.

Cybersecurity experience is a plus, not a requirement. What matters is executive acumen, judgment, attention to detail, and exceptional execution.

What Success Looks Like

  • Abnormal's event portfolio is delivered flawlessly, consistently, and at a standard people talk about afterward.
  • Executive programs create genuine relationships with the most influential security leaders in our market.
  • Sales, marketing, leadership, customers, and partners have an exceptional experience — and know exactly who to thank.
  • Budgets and resources are managed with discipline and transparency.
  • Every program has a clear measurement story and a defensible ROI.
  • Playbooks and standards exist that make the next event better than the last one.

Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.
In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Base salary range:
$118,600—$170,500 USD

These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards.

Free the Slaves has developed three (3) training modules - Module 1 – Educating and Mobilizing Vulnerable Communities, Module 2 – Survivor Liberation, Care and Reintegration, and Module 3 – Rule of Law and in the process of completing the fourth module - Ensuring Access to Essential Social and Economic Services. Task of Consultant

§ Work with Senior Country Program Manager for Ghana by providing regular updates and incorporate feedback from other Senior Staff of Free the Slaves

§ Develop online training presentation on the modules that is comprehensive but can be delivered within the shortest time possible

§ Share with FTS innovative tools to ensure effective online trainings, including training methods and tactics

FTS anticipated duration for this consultancy would be 20 days minimum and 25 days maximum.

§ Experience overseeing trainings and modules development

raw.description:
FreedUp is seeking a detail-oriented, discretion-first Operations & Contracts Support Specialist to support the founder of a boutique privacy consulting firm. This is not a classic calendar-and-inbox EA role — the founder manages her own schedule and email closely. Instead, this role is built around the operational and semi-legal busywork that pulls focus from client work: contracts and proposals, invoicing, vendor onboarding, and light HR/payroll administration.

This role suits someone who is comfortable with paralegal-style document work (redlining, SOWs, MSAs), enjoys process and precision, and can be trusted with sensitive client and financial information.

Location: Fully Remote (Brazil, Mexico, or Colombia)
Job Type: Full-Time
Salary: $1,000 - $1,700 per month (based on experience)

Requirements

  • 3+ years supporting a founder, attorney, or professional services firm in an operations, paralegal, or EA capacity
  • Experience with contract lifecycle basics — MSAs, SOWs, redlines, tracking/storage — even if not formally legal-trained
  • Comfort with invoicing/AP tools (e.g., Ramp) and vendor onboarding (W9s, etc.)
  • Exposure to payroll/PEO administration a plus
  • Familiarity with HubSpot or similar CRM/marketing tools
  • High discretion with confidential client and financial information — this firm works with enterprise clients on privacy/compliance matters
  • Excellent written English and strong attention to small details (this founder is exacting about precision)

Key Responsibilities

  • Contracts & Proposals
    • Turn approved proposals into SOWs and manage the MSA process
    • Track and manage redlines back-and-forth with clients; maintain organized contract records
  • Invoicing & Vendor Management
    • Own the (semi-automated) invoice process end-to-end
    • Manage vendor onboarding in Ramp, including W9 collection (~7–8 vendors/month)
  • HR & Payroll Administration
    • Handle recurring PEO tasks (payroll processing clicks, new-hire/contractor paperwork, benefits admin)
    • Coordinate small team touchpoints — security trainings, birthdays, onboarding welcomes
    • Support 6 employees and 4–6 contractors
  • Marketing & Client Onboarding Support
    • Assist with HubSpot admin tasks
    • Manage client onboarding forms and related paperwork
  • Nice to Have
    • Background touching legal/paralegal work, even informally
    • Experience supporting a founder at a professional services or consulting firm
    • Comfort learning firm-specific SOPs and Claude-based workflow skills

Benefits

  • International experience
  • Opportunity to work remotely from anywhere
  • Supportive and collaborative team environment
  • Learning and development opportunities
  • Potential Performance Bonuses
  • PTO
  • HMO after 3 months

A Principal Software Engineer for JAVA is an associate at Creative Chaos who is mainly responsible for developing server applications of various software platforms including but not limited to writing Restful APIs to be consumed by client applications. A Principal Software Engineer makes sure that the functionality, security and performance of the server application is as per the design and is completely bug free. Principal engineers have a responsibility to lead a team of engineers, mentor team members through continuous training and guidance.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Develop, test, debug, document, and maintain the back-end services, models, processes, and databases that support the application
  • Participate in development team activities to ensure consistently high levels of quality and productivity
  • Deep and rapidly growing experience with cloud architectures: security, availability, microservices, consumption-based billing, designs for scalability
  • Stay up-to-date on new technologies and development techniques to improve application quality and construction efficiency
  • Embrace agile principles and support iterative processes to maximize the delivery of valuable software
  • Provides technical expertise and advice for complex assignments and/or projects. Works with staff, contractors, and vendors to meet Company MIS needs.
  • In addition to staff level duties, performs complex design and/or analyses to meet a variety of business needs through technology.
  • Provides project leadership; may manage small to medium projects.
  • Presents recommendations to management and provides guidance in selecting alternatives.
  • Serves as a resource to others regarding highly technical areas and provides expertise to department management and others outside department/function.

Requirements

  • Minimum Bachelors in Computer Science/Software Engineering or equivalent.
  • Minimum has 8+ years professional experience in Java/Spring development, specifically developing commercial Spring MVC/Hibernate and AJAX web applications;
  • Experience in system integration, most significantly in designing, building, and consuming REST services;
  • Experience with PostgreSQL as DB Engine, deployed on AWS and relational DB skills for PostgreSQL & Terraform
  • Experience with React Js is a plus
  • Is comfortable working closely with business stakeholders, user experience designers, and quality assurance;
  • Embraces evolving requirements and specifications;
  • Possesses excellent and concise written & oral communication skills;
  • Believes in the value of test automation;

Benefits

  • Paid Time Off
  • Work From Home
  • Health Insurance
  • Provident Fund
  • OPD
  • Training and Development
  • Life Insurance
  • Exchange Program

title: District Manager
description: JOB DESCRIPTION:主要工作职责及内容:· 时间管理：• 50%的时间同代表协访；访后应对此进行分析评估并有书面记录。 • 20%的时间进行人员的绩效管理以及区域市场规划和评估 • 10%的时间参加PIM（科内会）。 • 10%的时间用于VIP以及相关部门的拜访。 • 10%的时间用于地区会议、完成本人和所负责区域内人员表格的输入和跟进工作，行政及其它工作。 · 绩效发展：• 每季初同每一位代表进行一次全面绩效发展回顾及规划。 • 每月初同每一位代表进行一次简要的绩效评估，制订相应的改进计划，并且有书面记录。 • 每季度应设定及跟踪新产品，重点产品，在三级和二级医院的进药情况。 • 每季度对所负责的区域进行绩效考核，根据达成率不同分不同的考核等级得出绩效结果，并做相应的后续措施 · 培训/人员发展• 在大区经理的指导下，协同培训经理进行实地培训和考核，主要涉及协访工作，严格访前、访中、访后程序，每周为代表至少改进一个日常拜访技巧或提高一项能力，并做书面记录。必须跟踪代表 10%的目标医生，跟进代表参加课堂培训后，对所学技能的持续使用和提高。 · 产品介绍会：• 地区经理每周至少参加一次代表的产品介绍会，并做评估和记录。 • 对代表的产品介绍会的效果分析评估应包括以下四个方面： • 是否达到进药的目的 • 是否提高产品的销量，尤其是目标医生处方的新病人的增加 • 目标医生的数量是否增加 • 是否将产品介绍会集中在主要医院 · 地区会议：（每周例会要求如下）• 讲解产品知识、业务技巧并做集体评估； • 本周业务回顾及下周计划； • 重要活动安排 • 重要信息发布。 • 每周产品使用情况和反馈 · VIP拜访：• 地区经理每月SFE要求拜访相关VIP，包括院长、副院长、药剂科主任，学术带头人和重要专家。每月协同商务人员拜访相关政府部门的官员，以保持良好的沟通。 · 市场活动：• 地区经理每月将各产品的业务情况和市场情况上报大区经理，同时抄送产品经理，并与产品经理保持良好的沟通，以争取产品经理的支持。市场活动必须同代表一起讨论，制定计划后需经产品经理、大区经理确认，确保所召开的市场活动的有效性，关注投入产出比。而且费用必须在财务打款后一个月内销帐。 · 日常工作时间：每天必须保证在区域内进行8小时的有效拜访工作。另外，地区经理应保证公司及客户在早8:00点起，至晚22:00点之前可以取得完全的联系，即意味着员工要在此规定时间内保持手机的开机状态。 · 报表管理The base pay for this position is N/AIn specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.

raw.description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

Cencora Global Consulting Services (GCS) — Value, Evidence & Access (VEA)


Join NeoOptima at Cencora and help shape the future of Medical Affairs and Medical Excellence. We are seeking a Director-level Medical Lead to drive strategic client engagements while helping build NeoOptima’s capabilities, offerings, and growth.

This role is ideal for a leader who combines scientific credibility, consulting strength, and commercial acumen to solve complex challenges across medical strategy, portfolio planning, field enablement, and AI-enabled Medical Affairs. The role spans both client delivery and internal business building, with approximately 50% of time focused on each, depending on business priorities and client needs.

We welcome candidates from across the United States. Given the global nature of the team and regular cross-region collaboration, candidates in the Eastern Time Zone or nearby time zones may find the working hours especially well aligned.


Responsibilities

  • Lead and deliver strategic advisory engagements across Medical Affairs and Medical Excellence for life sciences clients.
  • Shape and deliver solutions related to medical strategy, portfolio planning, field enablement, operating models, and AI-enabled Medical Affairs.
  • Support NeoOptima’s growth by contributing to capability building, strategic initiatives, thought leadership, and field enablement.
  • Assess current-state client capabilities and identify opportunities to improve effectiveness, scalability, and business impact.
  • Develop practical, actionable roadmaps to enhance Medical Affairs strategy, operations, and execution.
  • Partner with internal and external stakeholders to support solution development, proposals, and strategic client discussions.
  • Lead complex workstreams independently while managing multiple priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines.
  • Translate scientific and technical insights into clear, client-ready recommendations and deliverables.
  • Contribute to the development of reusable methodologies, tools, and best practices across NeoOptima and VEA.
  • Provide guidance to less-experienced team members and help drive consistent, high-quality delivery.

Education


Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in health economics, pharmacy administration, biostatistics, health services research, clinical epidemiology, public health, life sciences, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred

  • Master’s degree in health economics, epidemiology, public health, pharmacy, medicine, biostatistics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred Certifications

  • Certification in epidemiology or public health research
  • Certification in health economics and outcomes research
  • Certification in medical writing or scientific communications

Experience


Required

  • 6+ years of experience in one or more of the following:
    • Medical Affairs
    • Medical Excellence
    • Health outcomes research
    • Epidemiology
    • Health economics
    • Scientific consulting
    • Medical writing
    • Market access evidence
    • Related life sciences or consulting disciplines

Preferred

  • Experience leading or supporting strategic consulting engagements for pharmaceutical, biotech, or life sciences organizations
  • Experience improving Medical Affairs capabilities, operations, field models, or organizational effectiveness
  • Experience developing and presenting client-ready recommendations and strategic deliverables
  • Experience supporting proposal development, concept papers, and client solution design

Skills

  • Strong knowledge of health outcomes research, epidemiology, and observational study design principles
  • Understanding of health economics concepts, including value demonstration, evidence generation, and economic model development
  • Knowledge of systematic literature reviews, evidence synthesis methods, and scientific publication practices
  • Knowledge of protocol development, study reporting, and scientific communication standards across the research lifecycle
  • Familiarity with data sources, database structures, and analytical methods used in outcomes research and pharmacoepidemiology
  • Understanding of market access, payer evidence, and field-based evidence applications within life sciences consulting
  • Skill in designing and delivering health outcomes and epidemiology studies from concept through final report
  • Skill in developing scientific content for protocols, study reports, abstracts, posters, manuscripts, and presentations
  • Skill in synthesizing clinical, epidemiologic, and economic evidence into clear and actionable insights
  • Skill in contributing to economic models, value dossiers, systematic reviews, and related evidence-generation deliverables
  • Strong medical writing and client communication skills
  • Ability to analyze multiple data sources and document methods, rationale, and outputs clearly
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple assignments with minimal guidance
  • Ability to deliver complex consulting assignments independently within scope, quality, and timeline expectations
  • Ability to communicate technical findings effectively in writing, presentations, and stakeholder discussions
  • Ability to identify and implement process improvements that reduce rework and improve consistency
  • Ability to coach less-experienced professionals and contribute to reusable resources and best practices

What You’ll Bring

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗕𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗼 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗧𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲

raw.description:
Senior Sales Development Representative (B2B)

About GNO Partners

GNO Partners was founded by Gal and Ouriel, who built two successful Amazon brands from scratch to an almost 8-figure exit.

We help 7- and 8-figure Amazon FBA sellers scale their businesses by implementing our proven systems and strategies. Our fully remote team of experts has worked with over 1,300 brands and is currently partnered with around 500 active clients.

We are not a "Done-For-You" agency but a consulting firm with a "Done-With-You" service model. We provide hands-on expertise to help our clients improve profits and revenues while integrating complete systems, processes, and frameworks so they can scale and manage their Amazon brand like top (7 & 8-figure) operators independently, without relying on us long term.

We are scaling fast and looking for A-players to join our growing sales team. If you're highly motivated, coachable, and competitive, keep reading.

Why This Role Is Different

Most SDR jobs make you build your own lists. Here you don't. The leads are scraped and curated for you, the offer is easy to say yes to on a cold call, and the people you're calling are business owners who already have real revenue and real problems we solve. Your only job is to get on the phone and book.

Why Join GNO Partners

  • Competitive base pay plus performance commissions and bonuses
  • All leads provided, no prospecting or list building
  • A cold-friendly offer that makes booking meetings easier
  • Daily coaching and a team that wants you to win
  • Fast-paced, performance-driven environment with clear opportunities for growth
  • Work directly with experienced operators who have scaled and exited Amazon brands

About the Role

This is an outbound sales development role. You'll be the first point of contact with Amazon sellers, engaging them by phone to book qualified discovery calls for our Account Executives.

About 90% of your day is outbound cold calling Amazon brand owners from curated lists. The other 10% is handling inbound leads from our paid campaigns.

Responsibilities

  • Cold call Amazon brand owners from pre-qualified lead lists
  • Book qualified discovery calls for the sales team
  • Drive show-up rates with consistent, professional follow-ups
  • Accurately track all activity in the CRM and report on performance

What Success Looks Like

  • You hit your daily call and booking KPIs consistently
  • The calls you book show up and are qualified, not just on the calendar
  • You take feedback today and it shows up on your calls tomorrow

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in an SDR, BDR, or phone-based sales role, including cold calling
  • Confident on the phone, comfortable handling objections and pushing for the meeting
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and responsive
  • Comfortable using tools like Gmail, Slack, Nooks, Instantly, and Pipedrive
  • Coachable, driven, and accountable to daily KPIs
  • Bonus: Experience in e-commerce, digital marketing, or Amazon FBA

This Role Is NOT For You If

  • You don't like being on the phone most of the day
  • You need a lot of hand-holding to hit your numbers
  • You get defensive when someone gives you feedback

Details

  • Full-Time
  • Fully Remote
  • Must have working hour overlap with U.S. Eastern Time

If you love the phone, love winning, and want to be part of a team that's growing fast, apply now. We move quickly with strong candidates.

A Principal Software Engineer for JAVA is an associate at Creative Chaos who is mainly responsible for developing server applications of various software platforms including but not limited to writing Restful APIs to be consumed by client applications. A Principal Software Engineer makes sure that the functionality, security and performance of the server application is as per the design and is completely bug free. Principal engineers have a responsibility to lead a team of engineers, mentor team members through continuous training and guidance.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Develop, test, debug, document, and maintain the back-end services, models, processes, and databases that support the application
  • Participate in development team activities to ensure consistently high levels of quality and productivity
  • Deep and rapidly growing experience with cloud architectures: security, availability, microservices, consumption-based billing, designs for scalability
  • Stay up-to-date on new technologies and development techniques to improve application quality and construction efficiency
  • Embrace agile principles and support iterative processes to maximize the delivery of valuable software
  • Provides technical expertise and advice for complex assignments and/or projects. Works with staff, contractors, and vendors to meet Company MIS needs.
  • In addition to staff level duties, performs complex design and/or analyses to meet a variety of business needs through technology.
  • Provides project leadership; may manage small to medium projects.
  • Presents recommendations to management and provides guidance in selecting alternatives.
  • Serves as a resource to others regarding highly technical areas and provides expertise to department management and others outside department/function.

Requirements

  • Minimum Bachelors in Computer Science/Software Engineering or equivalent.
  • Minimum has 8+ years professional experience in Java/Spring development, specifically developing commercial Spring MVC/Hibernate and AJAX web applications;
  • Experience in system integration, most significantly in designing, building, and consuming REST services;
  • Experience with PostgreSQL as DB Engine, deployed on AWS and relational DB skills for PostgreSQL & Terraform
  • Experience with React Js is a plus
  • Is comfortable working closely with business stakeholders, user experience designers, and quality assurance;
  • Embraces evolving requirements and specifications;
  • Possesses excellent and concise written & oral communication skills;
  • Believes in the value of test automation;

Benefits

  • Paid Time Off
  • Work From Home
  • Health Insurance
  • Provident Fund
  • OPD
  • Training and Development
  • Life Insurance
  • Exchange Program

description: JOB DESCRIPTION:主要工作职责及内容:· 时间管理：• 50%的时间同代表协访；访后应对此进行分析评估并有书面记录。 • 20%的时间进行人员的绩效管理以及区域市场规划和评估 • 10%的时间参加PIM（科内会）。 • 10%的时间用于VIP以及相关部门的拜访。 • 10%的时间用于地区会议、完成本人和所负责区域内人员表格的输入和跟进工作，行政及其它工作。 · 绩效发展：• 每季初同每一位代表进行一次全面绩效发展回顾及规划。 • 每月初同每一位代表进行一次简要的绩效评估，制订相应的改进计划，并且有书面记录。 • 每季度应设定及跟踪新产品，重点产品，在三级和二级医院的进药情况。 • 每季度对所负责的区域进行绩效考核，根据达成率不同分不同的考核等级得出绩效结果，并做相应的后续措施 · 培训/人员发展• 在大区经理的指导下，协同培训经理进行实地培训和考核，主要涉及协访工作，严格访前、访中、访后程序，每周为代表至少改进一个日常拜访技巧或提高一项能力，并做书面记录。必须跟踪代表 10%的目标医生，跟进代表参加课堂培训后，对所学技能的持续使用和提高。 · 产品介绍会：• 地区经理每周至少参加一次代表的产品介绍会，并做评估和记录。 • 对代表的产品介绍会的效果分析评估应包括以下四个方面： • 是否达到进药的目的 • 是否提高产品的销量，尤其是目标医生处方的新病人的增加 • 目标医生的数量是否增加 • 是否将产品介绍会集中在主要医院 · 地区会议：（每周例会要求如下）• 讲解产品知识、业务技巧并做集体评估； • 本周业务回顾及下周计划； • 重要活动安排 • 重要信息发布。 • 每周产品使用情况和反馈 · VIP拜访：• 地区经理每月SFE要求拜访相关VIP，包括院长、副院长、药剂科主任，学术带头人和重要专家。每月协同商务人员拜访相关政府部门的官员，以保持良好的沟通。 · 市场活动：• 地区经理每月将各产品的业务情况和市场情况上报大区经理，同时抄送产品经理，并与产品经理保持良好的沟通，以争取产品经理的支持。市场活动必须同代表一起讨论，制定计划后需经产品经理、大区经理确认，确保所召开的市场活动的有效性，关注投入产出比。而且费用必须在财务打款后一个月内销帐。 · 日常工作时间：每天必须保证在区域内进行8小时的有效拜访工作。另外，地区经理应保证公司及客户在早8:00点起，至晚22:00点之前可以取得完全的联系，即意味着员工要在此规定时间内保持手机的开机状态。 · 报表管理The base pay for this position is N/AIn specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.

raw.description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

Cencora Global Consulting Services (GCS) — Value, Evidence & Access (VEA)


Join NeoOptima at Cencora and help shape the future of Medical Affairs and Medical Excellence. We are seeking a Director-level Medical Lead to drive strategic client engagements while helping build NeoOptima’s capabilities, offerings, and growth.

This role is ideal for a leader who combines scientific credibility, consulting strength, and commercial acumen to solve complex challenges across medical strategy, portfolio planning, field enablement, and AI-enabled Medical Affairs. The role spans both client delivery and internal business building, with approximately 50% of time focused on each, depending on business priorities and client needs.

We welcome candidates from across the United States. Given the global nature of the team and regular cross-region collaboration, candidates in the Eastern Time Zone or nearby time zones may find the working hours especially well aligned.


Responsibilities

  • Lead and deliver strategic advisory engagements across Medical Affairs and Medical Excellence for life sciences clients.
  • Shape and deliver solutions related to medical strategy, portfolio planning, field enablement, operating models, and AI-enabled Medical Affairs.
  • Support NeoOptima’s growth by contributing to capability building, strategic initiatives, thought leadership, and field enablement.
  • Assess current-state client capabilities and identify opportunities to improve effectiveness, scalability, and business impact.
  • Develop practical, actionable roadmaps to enhance Medical Affairs strategy, operations, and execution.
  • Partner with internal and external stakeholders to support solution development, proposals, and strategic client discussions.
  • Lead complex workstreams independently while managing multiple priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines.
  • Translate scientific and technical insights into clear, client-ready recommendations and deliverables.
  • Contribute to the development of reusable methodologies, tools, and best practices across NeoOptima and VEA.
  • Provide guidance to less-experienced team members and help drive consistent, high-quality delivery.

Education


Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in health economics, pharmacy administration, biostatistics, health services research, clinical epidemiology, public health, life sciences, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred

  • Master’s degree in health economics, epidemiology, public health, pharmacy, medicine, biostatistics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred Certifications

  • Certification in epidemiology or public health research
  • Certification in health economics and outcomes research
  • Certification in medical writing or scientific communications

Experience


Required

  • 6+ years of experience in one or more of the following:
    • Medical Affairs
    • Medical Excellence
    • Health outcomes research
    • Epidemiology
    • Health economics
    • Scientific consulting
    • Medical writing
    • Market access evidence
    • Related life sciences or consulting disciplines

Preferred

  • Experience leading or supporting strategic consulting engagements for pharmaceutical, biotech, or life sciences organizations
  • Experience improving Medical Affairs capabilities, operations, field models, or organizational effectiveness
  • Experience developing and presenting client-ready recommendations and strategic deliverables
  • Experience supporting proposal development, concept papers, and client solution design

Skills

  • Strong knowledge of health outcomes research, epidemiology, and observational study design principles
  • Understanding of health economics concepts, including value demonstration, evidence generation, and economic model development
  • Knowledge of systematic literature reviews, evidence synthesis methods, and scientific publication practices
  • Knowledge of protocol development, study reporting, and scientific communication standards across the research lifecycle
  • Familiarity with data sources, database structures, and analytical methods used in outcomes research and pharmacoepidemiology
  • Understanding of market access, payer evidence, and field-based evidence applications within life sciences consulting
  • Skill in designing and delivering health outcomes and epidemiology studies from concept through final report
  • Skill in developing scientific content for protocols, study reports, abstracts, posters, manuscripts, and presentations
  • Skill in synthesizing clinical, epidemiologic, and economic evidence into clear and actionable insights
  • Skill in contributing to economic models, value dossiers, systematic reviews, and related evidence-generation deliverables
  • Strong medical writing and client communication skills
  • Ability to analyze multiple data sources and document methods, rationale, and outputs clearly

Our client is a tier-one global cryptocurrency exchange known for industry-leading liquidity, deep digital asset coverage, and high-volume trading infrastructure serving tens of millions of users worldwide.

To scale the next phase of their systematic trading business, they are hiring a Senior Quant Trader to own and run a profitable book across delta-one instruments — spot, perpetuals, and futures — spanning high-frequency liquidity strategies through to mid-frequency statistical arbitrage and cross-sectional alpha.

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗕𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗼 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗧𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲

  • 𝗤𝘂𝗮𝗻𝘁𝗶𝘁𝗮𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗣𝗲𝗱𝗶𝗴𝗿𝗲𝗲: Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Statistics, or Engineering.
  • 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗻 𝗣𝗻𝗟 𝗧𝗿𝗮𝗰𝗸 𝗥𝗲𝗰𝗼𝗿𝗱: History of deploying and managing profitable systematic strategies, HFT/liquidity provision, mid-frequency stat arb, CTA/trend, or cross-sectional alpha — with the temperament to own a live book.

GNO Partners was founded by Gal and Ouriel, who built two successful Amazon brands from scratch to an almost 8-figure exit.

We help 7- and 8-figure Amazon FBA sellers scale their businesses by implementing our proven systems and strategies. Our fully remote team of experts has worked with over 1,300 brands and is currently partnered with around 500 active clients.

We provide hands-on expertise to help our clients improve profits and revenues while integrating complete systems, processes, and frameworks so they can scale and manage their Amazon brand like top (7 & 8-figure) operators independently, without relying on us long term.

We are scaling fast and looking for A-players to join our growing sales team. If you're highly motivated, coachable, and competitive, keep reading.

Why This Role Is Different

Most SDR jobs make you build your own lists. Here you don't. The leads are scraped and curated for you, the offer is easy to say yes to on a cold call, and the people you're calling are business owners who already have real revenue and real problems we solve. Your only job is to get on the phone and book.

Why Join GNO Partners

  • Competitive base pay plus performance commissions and bonuses
  • All leads provided, no prospecting or list building

  • Daily coaching and a team that wants you to win

This is an outbound sales development role. You'll be the first point of contact with Amazon sellers, engaging them by phone to book qualified discovery calls for our Account Executives.

About 90% of your day is outbound cold calling Amazon brand owners from curated lists. The other 10% is handling inbound leads from our paid campaigns.

Responsibilities

  • Cold call Amazon brand owners from pre-qualified lead lists
  • Book qualified discovery calls for the sales team
  • Drive show-up rates with consistent, professional follow-ups

  • Coachable, driven, and accountable to daily KPIs

This Role Is NOT For You If

Details

  • Full-Time
  • Fully Remote

If you love the phone, love winning, and want to be part of a team that's growing fast, apply now. We move quickly with strong candidates.

Cognite operates at the forefront of industrial digitalization, building AI, and data solutions that solve the world’s hardest, highest-impact problems. With unmatched industrial heritage and a comprehensive suite of AI capabilities, including low-code AI agents, Cognite accelerates the digital transformation to drive operational improvements.

We thrive in challenges. We challenge assumptions. We execute with speed and ownership. If you view obstacles as signals to step forward - not backwards - you’ll feel right at home here.

Our Moonshot is bold: Unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works. Join us in this venture where AI and data meet ingenuity, and together, we will forge the path to a smarter, more connected industrial future.

Location: Field / Remote

Travel: Approximately 50% (Client sites, etc)

About Cognite

Cognite is a global industrial Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) company enabling the full-scale digital transformation of heavy-asset industries. Our core software product, Cognite Data Fusion (CDF), powers companies with contextualized OT/IT data to develop and scale solutions that increase safety, sustainability, and operational efficiency while driving revenue.

Role Overview

As a Business Development Director within our Supply Chain Center of Excellence (CoE), you will drive Cognite’s growth by winning new Supply Chain business within accounts headquartered in your territory. Operating as a subject matter expert, you will leverage deep domain insights to help customers transform their supply chain value chain using Cognite Applications and the Cognite Data Fusion Platform.

Key Responsibilities

  • Territory & CoE Strategy: Develop and execute a targeted territory strategy to accelerate bookings growth and secure high-impact supply chain clients.
  • Pipeline Generation: Actively prospect and leverage your personal network to generate pipeline, providing compelling "commercial insights" on optimizing the supply chain value chain.
  • Complex Sales Execution: Lead extended territory teams (including pre-sales and technical experts) through complex enterprise sales cycles to exceed bookings targets.
  • Value-Based Selling: Quantify ROI and present strong business cases to help enterprise executives justify software investments.
  • Partner-savvy: work with partners to qualify and progress their pipeline, and drive joint engagements on qualified opportunities.
  • Deal Negotiation: Support the Account / Engagement Leader in negotiating favorable pricing and commercial terms with C-level executives by demonstrating the long-term strategic value of Cognite’s solutions.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with internal Product Management and Marketing teams to feed real-market supply chain insights back into product strategy.
  • Sales Hygiene & Forecasting: Support the Account Leaders and their First Line Managers in accurately forecasting monthly/quarterly bookings and maintaining up-to-date account records in .

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities (KSAs) & Competencies

Core Competencies:

  • Domain & Industry Expertise: Deep domain expertise in complex Supply Chain operations for Energy, Manufacturing or Power Utilities verticals. Understanding of Production operations and industry x.0 initiatives is also required.
  • Strategic Value Selling: Ability to sell value and build quantified ROI frameworks for prospective buyers.
  • Informal Leadership, Influence & Autonomy: High degree of self-motivation, time management, and ability to informally lead and effectively influence cross-functional deal teams.
  • Executive Communication: Stellar presentation, written, and verbal communication skills tailored for C-suite engagement.

Knowledge & Technical Requirements:

  • Enterprise Software/SaaS: Proven mastery of selling complex analytics or data platforms (e.g., AI, Big Data, Data Warehousing, Business Intelligence, Machine Learning).
  • Data Ecosystems: Familiarity with modern data architectures and tools, such as Big Data frameworks (Hadoop, Spark, Hive, BigQuery), Data Warehouses, and Machine Learning.

Role Qualifications

  • Industry Experience: 10+ years of experience in the Manufacturing and broader industrial supply chain environment.
  • Sales Track Record: 7+ years of direct or in-support sales experience, selling enterprise software/SaaS (BI, Big Data, Advanced Analytics, or AI/ML) to C-level executives, Management and operations.
  • Proven Performance: Demonstrated history of consistently meeting or exceeding SaaS bookings goals in direct / partner / channel-based sales models
  • Environment Experience: Prior experience operating in high-growth startup environments (Series A, B, or C stage).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree required.

What Makes Us Great & Perks

  • Culture & Values: High autonomy, a culture of speed and openness, social and diversity initiatives (Together@Cognite), and a commitment to innovation.
  • Compensation & Benefits: Competitive base + variable compensation, 401(k) employer matching, fully covered health/dental/vision/disability premiums, and learning stipends.
  • Workplace Flexibility: Unlimited PTO, paid parental leave, and catered company lunches.

Learn more about us

  • Impact 2025
  • Cognite's Industrial AI: Moonshot
  • We’re globally recognized domain experts with an international presence that spans Phoenix, Houston, Oslo Tokyo, Bengaluru, and Abu Dhabi.
Equal Opportunity
Cognite is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment at work and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive the same level of consideration for employment.

About JumpCloud®

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.

About the Team:

The Sales Engineering team is rapidly expanding to support our sales functions and equip our salespeople with the technical resources they need to help drive revenue growth. The Pre-Sales Engineering team is responsible for providing technical expertise and consulting to organizations during their evaluation and to help show the value of JumpCloud solutions.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Acting as the technical trusted advisor to provide consultative support for organizations across the South East Asia region (SEA) evaluating the JumpCloud platform

  • Providing tailored product demonstrations

  • Uncovering customer pain points and challenges and aligning JumpCloud solutions to those challenges

  • Support direct and partner sales teams with product related questions and skill development

  • Building relationships with partners through technical enablement and co-selling

  • Assist prospects with setup and configuration of free trials

  • Provide technical Q&A to prospects as they progress through trial

  • Assess prospect readiness to enter a formal sales cycle

  • Understand implementation best practices to advise on the quickest customer time to value

  • Identify common technical issues and themes that could be addressed through product development, automation and/or self-serve

  • Provide evaluation framework for prospects to follow in their POC

We’re looking for :

  • Excellent written and verbal communications skills with the ability to communicate in local languages such as Mandarin, Cantonese and English

  • Skilled at breaking down complex tasks into simple actionable steps for customers

  • Comfortable speaking with technical evaluators and IT leaders, and adjusting talk-track to match the audience

  • Desire and ability to learn new complex concepts

Preferred Qualifications :

  • 3-5+ experience in a technical Sales Engineering or similar role

  • Strong knowledge of Cloud/SaaS technologies

  • Strong understanding of Active Directory environments

  • Understanding of networking Fundamentals

  • Knowledgeable in industry standard authentication and authorization protocols e.g. SAML, OIDC/OAuth, LDAP, RADIUS, SCIM and JIT

  • Familiarity with MDM, RMM, or similar endpoint solutions

  • Familiarity with MFA technologies such as TOTP, WebAuthn

  • Experience configuring and deploying identity and/or directory solutions

  • Experience with both direct and channel/partner sales cycles

Where you’ll be working/Location:

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.
This role is remote in the country of Singapore. You must be located in and authorized to work in Singapore to be considered for this role.

Language:

JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

Why JumpCloud®?

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.
One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO
Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.
JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Scam Notice:

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.
All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at with the subject line "Scam Notice"
